new_roles.title: Director Quality & Compliance
new_roles.description:
**Job Description:**

**Who We Are:**

At Cart.com, we're **defining the future of commerce.**

Founded to solve the growing complexity of modern commerce, Cart.com helps businesses simplify how they sell, fulfill, and deliver products to their customers. We bring together technology, services, and logistics infrastructure into one connected platform, making it easier for organizations to grow, operate efficiently, and navigate an increasingly fragmented commerce landscape.

We work with brands, retailers, manufacturers, and public sector organizations to support every stage of the customer journey, from ecommerce and order management to fulfillment, distribution, and delivery. By combining software, expertise, and a nationwide logistics network into a unified solution, we help our customers move faster, operate smarter, and scale with confidence.

But what truly sets Cart.com apart is our people. We're builders, problem-solvers, and innovators who thrive on turning big challenges into meaningful outcomes for our customers. Every day, we're helping shape the future of commerce while creating opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact.

If you're energized by solving complex problems, collaborating with talented teammates, and helping build what's next, we'd love to hear from you.

**Cart.com Milestones**

* Founded in 2020 with a vision to build the first truly unified commerce platform.
* Achieved unicorn status with a valuation exceeding $1 billion.
* Raised more than $475 million to support continued growth and innovation
* Expanded a nationwide commerce and logistics network that helps organizations scale, fulfill, and grow across channels.
* Recognized by Inc.'s Power Partner Awards for helping businesses grow and scale.
* Recognized as an award-winning employer for four consecutive years, reflecting our commitment to building an environment where talented people can grow, innovate, and make an impact.

**Our values:** Cart.com is building a company that is committed to living out these 6 core values:

* **Be brand obsessed:** Our lives are shaped by the brands we interact with daily. We obsess over the brands we serve, and about the things they care about.
* **Think beyond the box:** “We’ve always done it that way” is not a phrase uttered often at our office. We create creative solutions to complex problems.

* **Don’t give up:** We learn from our challenges and see them for what they are; great building blocks to an amazing brand story.
* **Speak up:** We communicate clearly and directly because we care deeply. Communication is the bedrock of our community.
* **Work together:** We’ve built a team that prides itself on diversity of thought and background. Collaboration is better with contrast.
* **Remember to be human:** We work hard, but we leave room for the people, places and things that we love

**AI is part of how we work. It's not doing the hiring.** 
 
We'll use AI in parts of our process and we think you should feel free to use it too — for research, prep, whatever helps. But our interviews exist to meet *you*, not your best AI-assisted draft. Real people make every call here. Any questions about how this works, just ask.

**Remote:**

This position is fully remote and open to candidates in AZ, CA, CO, CT, DC, DE, FL, GA, HI, IL, IN, KY, LA, MA, MD, MI, MO, MS, NC, NJ, NY, NC, OH, OR, PA, SC, TN, TX, UT, VA, WA. The salary range for this role is $175,000-200,000 annually. Actual compensation may vary based on geographic location, experience and qualifications. This role is eligible for bonus, equity and benefits including medical, dental, vision, 401(k), paid time off. Applications accepted through 1-31-2027. We comply with all applicable pay transparency laws in the states where we operate.

**The Role:**

The Director, Quality and Compliance leads the quality function for Cart.com’s federal pharmaceutical distribution business across four sites. This leader will standardize and strengthen an established quality program, develop site quality leaders, ensure consistent application of procedures, and serve as the primary quality point of contact for client reporting, audits and product-quality events.

This is approximately a 70% strategic leadership and 30% hands-on role. The Director will not build the program from the ground up, but will assess the current-state program, make targeted improvements, and ensure teams consistently execute against client, regulatory and network requirements. The role is remote with approximately 30% travel.

**What You’ll Do**

* Lead and develop site quality leaders across Maryland, Goodyear, Temecula and Memphis, establishing clear accountability, delegation and follow-through.
* Standardize quality procedures and expectations across the network while refining the existing quality management system and closing identified gaps.
* Ensure sites remain prepared for client and regulatory audits; support audit planning, host or coordinate inspections, and oversee timely responses and corrective actions.
* Serve as the primary quality point of contact for pharmaceutical product excursions and related client reporting, ensuring submissions are accurate, complete and timely.
* Oversee quality processes supporting receiving, quarantine, release, disposition, returns, destruction, recalls, deviations, corrective and preventive actions, change control, training, complaints and document control.
* Guide quality decisions for controlled-temperature pharmaceutical products, including refrigerated, frozen and ultra-cold storage and distribution.
* Partner with site Operations leaders and Cart.com’s Compliance team to implement operational changes required to meet quality standards and client expectations.
* Use quality metrics, audit findings, client feedback and site observations to identify risk, prioritize improvements and report progress to senior leadership.
* Travel to sites for audit preparation, team development, quality reviews and issue resolution.

**Who You Are:**

 

* You are a strategic, hands-on quality leader who can set direction while stepping into audits, excursions and site-readiness work when needed.
* You lead through others, delegate clearly, establish checkpoints and hold site quality leaders accountable for follow-through.
* You put the client’s requirements first, ask the right questions and respond with accurate, timely information.
* You communicate with credibility and composure across clients, regulators, Operations, Compliance and senior leadership.
* You are highly organized and disciplined, ensuring commitments, documentation and escalations do not get lost.
* You build strong cross-functional partnerships and can influence operational changes without creating a separate quality silo.
* You adapt to changing federal-client requirements while maintaining consistent quality standards and sound judgment.
* You develop people, address performance gaps directly and create a culture of ownership across a distributed team.

**What You’ve Done:**

 

* 7+ years of progressive pharmaceutical quality experience, including work in a current Good Manufacturing Practice (cGMP) environment.
* 5+ years of people-leadership experience with demonstrated success delegating, developing leaders and holding teams accountable. Direct leadership of quality teams is preferred.
* Worked in pharmaceutical distribution, wholesale, logistics or third-party logistics (3PL). Manufacturing experience alone is not sufficient without meaningful distribution-quality exposure.
* Applied cGMP, Good Distribution Practice (GDP), controlled-document and standard operating procedure requirements in a regulated pharmaceutical environment.
* Prepared for or led audits involving the U.S. Food and Drug Administration or comparable regulators, including managing responses and follow-up actions.
* Supported pharmaceutical product release, disposition, holds, recalls or temperature-excursion decisions in a regulated distribution setting.
* Written, revised or implemented quality procedures and documentation, then ensured consistent execution across teams or sites.
* Led a distributed or multi-site team and built accountability through site leaders rather than personally owning every task.
* Managed a significant client, product-quality or regulatory issue requiring coordination across Quality, Operations and Compliance.
* Earned a bachelor’s degree in life sciences, pharmacy, biology, chemistry or a related field, or bring an equivalent combination of relevant education and experience.
* Ability to travel up to 30%.

**Nice to Haves:**

 

* Background supporting federal health programs or agencies such as HHS, DLA, ASPR, BARDA, DoD or VA.
* Experience with pharmaceutical 3PLs, wholesalers, state licensing or NABP accreditation.
* Hands-on experience with vaccines or other cold-chain and ultra-cold pharmaceutical products.
* Knowledge of Drug Supply Chain Security Act requirements and suspect or illegitimate product processes.
* Relevant certifications such as ASQ Certified Quality Auditor, Certified Manager of Quality/Organizational Excellence, Certified Pharmaceutical GMP Professional or Lead Auditor.
* Master’s degree in a life-sciences or related discipline.

**Physical Demands & Working Conditions:**

 

* Remote work environment with regular computer and video-conference use.
* Ability to travel by air or ground up to 30% and work onsite in warehouse, pharmaceutical distribution and temperature-controlled environments.
* Ability to move through operating areas and wear required personal protective equipment when visiting sites.
* Flexibility to support audits, client needs or quality events outside standard business hours when required.

Eligibility Requirement: This position is open only to U.S. citizens due to applicable federal requirements. By applying, you confirm that you are a U.S. citizen and can provide acceptable documentation verifying your status if selected. 
 
If you are not a U.S. citizen, please do not apply for this role.

Cart.com is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

new_roles.description:
*Reports To: SVP and General Manager, Business Operations*

**About Luminary Hospice:**
---------------------------

At Luminary Hospice, we are a mission-driven organization that empowers our team members to shape our culture in order to allow them to provide the highest quality support to patients and families throughout their entire end-of-life journey.

Our mission is to deliver personalized care that radiates compassion and preserves dignity for all that we are honored to serve on their end-of-life journey. We are centered on caring for the whole person – with expert medical care, pain management as well as emotional and spiritual support along with resources, information, and emotional support for families and caregivers.

### **About the role:**

The Director of Quality is responsible for leading, designing, and continuously improving the organization's Quality Assurance and Performance Improvement (QAPI) program. This role ensures compliance with all federal, state, and accrediting body requirements while driving a culture of safety, accountability, and high-quality patient care. The Director of Quality partners closely with clinical, operational, and executive leadership to translate quality data into meaningful improvements that enhance patient outcomes, regulatory readiness, and organizational performance.

This leader serves as the organization's subject-matter expert on quality, survey preparedness, and performance improvement, balancing regulatory rigor with practical, frontline-focused solutions.

**Job Responsibilities**

**Quality & Performance Improvement**

* Lead and oversee the organization's QAPI program, ensuring alignment with CMS Conditions of Participation, state regulations, and accreditation standards.

* Develop, implement, and monitor performance improvement initiatives based on data trends, adverse events, and regulatory requirements.

* Analyze quality metrics, patient outcomes, and incident reports to identify risks, root causes, and opportunities for improvement.

* Ensure corrective action plans are developed, implemented, and sustained across departments and markets. (Let's discuss with Nicole)

**Regulatory Compliance & Survey Readiness**

* Serve as the primary owner of regulatory readiness, including CMS, state surveys, and accrediting body reviews.

* Lead mock surveys, tracer activities, and ongoing readiness assessments to ensure continuous compliance.

* Coordinate survey responses, plans of correction, and follow-up activities in partnership with agency leadership.

* Stay current on regulatory changes and proactively educate leaders on impact and expectations.

**Patient Safety & Risk Management**

* Oversee patient safety initiatives, including incident reporting, investigations, and follow-up actions.

* Lead root cause analyses (RCAs) and failure mode assessments as needed.

* Partner with clinical leadership to reduce risk, prevent harm, and improve safety outcomes for patients and staff.

**Data, Reporting & Insights**

* Develop and maintain quality dashboards and reports for executive leadership, agency leaders, and governing bodies.

* Translate complex quality and compliance data into clear, actionable insights.

* Ensure accurate and timely reporting of required quality measures and outcomes.

**Leadership, Education & Collaboration**

* Partner with Executive Directors, Clinical Leaders, and Medical Directors to embed quality expectations into daily operations.

* Educate and coach leaders and frontline staff on quality standards, best practices, and regulatory requirements.

* Support a culture of transparency, continuous learning, and accountability.

* Participate in leadership meetings and provide strategic guidance on quality-related decisions.

**Job Qualifications**

* Registered Nurse (RN) with active, unrestricted license

* Minimum 5 years of hospice or home health experience

* Minimum 3 years in quality, compliance, or clinical leadership

* Strong knowledge of CMS Hospice Conditions of Participation

* Experience with surveys and regulatory audits

* Strong analytical and communication skills

**Preferred**

* Hospice or quality certification (CHPN, CPHQ, or similar)

* Experience with accreditation organizations (CHAP, ACHC, Joint Commission)

### **Physical Demands:**

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is frequently required to sit or stand. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 50 pounds.

### **Equal Employment Opportunity:**

Luminary Hospice is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace. We do not discriminate against any applicant or employee based on race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. We are committed to providing a work environment free from discrimination and harassment, where all individuals are treated with respect and dignity. All employment decisions at Luminary Hospice are based on business needs, job requirements, and individual qualifications.

### **Compensation and Benefits:**

Luminary Hospice offers a competitive compensation package, along with a comprehensive benefits package that includes health, dental, and vision insurance, retirement savings options, and more. Our benefits are designed to support your health, well-being, and long-term financial goals.

new_roles.title: Director-Quality Management - Acute
new_roles.description:
Director-Quality Management - Acute | Highland Hospital | Charleston, West Virginia

**About the Job:**

PURPOSE STATEMENT: 
 
The Director of Quality, Risk & Compliance leads and coordinates quality and performance improvement, regulatory compliance, and patient safety efforts within the healthcare facility. This role ensures that all programs operate within local, state, federal, and accreditation standards, while driving a culture of continuous improvement, clinical excellence, and risk reduction.

**Roles and Responsibilities:**

**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:**

* Provides oversight of all facility programs, including inpatient and outpatient services, ensuring alignment with quality, risk management, patient safety, and regulatory standards.
* Leads facility-wide quality, risk, and patient safety strategy and improvement efforts.
* Directs the Quality Assurance/Performance Improvement (QAPI) program, including development, implementation, and evaluation; monitors KPIs and ensures governance of data-driven improvement efforts.
* Drives organization-wide performance improvement initiatives through data analysis and system-level process enhancements to improve outcomes.
* Oversees incident reporting, investigations, and risk analyses (RCA/Event Analysis), ensuring timely resolution and prevention of recurrence.
* Maintains compliance with all local, state, federal (CMS), and accreditation standards (TJC), ensures ongoing survey readiness, and serves as the primary liaison during regulatory and accreditation surveys, audits, and required reporting activities.
* Partners with the Legal, Compliance, and Risk Department on high-risk events, complaints/allegations, investigations, and corrective action planning.
* Supports the development, review, and implementation of facility policies and procedures, ensuring alignment with regulatory requirements and consistent adherence across departments.
* Collaborates with department leaders and Human Resources to support staff accountability and ensure adherence to facility policies and procedures.
* Provides staff training and mentoring to support competency, accountability, and adherence to quality, risk, and safety standards, while fostering a culture of continuous improvement and patient safety.
* Conducts leadership rounding, medical record reviews, and monitoring of environment of care, safety, and documentation standards.
* Prepares and maintains required reports and documentation; participates in committees, meetings, audits, and organizational initiatives.
* Supervises Patient Advocate/Coordinator roles, when applicable, through hiring, orienting, performance assessment and management, motivating, training, scheduling, and coaching to meet department and facility goals. Supports resolution of patient concerns and patient rights processes.
* Serves as Patient Safety and Compliance Officer, providing oversight of patient safety, risk management, and event reporting processes within organizational governance structures.
* Serves as Patient Safety and Compliance Officer, providing oversight of client safety, risk management, and event reporting processes within organizational governance structures.
* May serve as Privacy/Security Officer, providing direction and oversight of activities related to compliance with applicable Federal and State law and regulations governing the privacy and security of health information.
* May serve as Chief Healthcare Disparities Officer, leading efforts to identify, analyze, and reduce disparities in care for the populations served.
* May be required to provide onsite coverage for other programs when needed, develops, and executes new programs according to market needs and may provide training, case consultation and Administrator On Call coverage during and after program hours as needed.

**EDUCATION/EXPERIENCE/SKILL REQUIREMENTS:**

* Bachelor’s degree with a clinical, nursing or business emphasis required. Master’s degree in Human Services preferred.
* Three years’ experience in quality, patient safety, regulatory compliance, risk management, survey management, behavioral health, substance use disorder treatment, or related experience required.
* Knowledge and understanding of state/federal regulations, Joint Commission and/or CARF Accreditation.

**LICENSES/DESIGNATIONS/CERTIFICATIONS:**

* CPHQ Preferred
* Professional clinical license issued by the appropriate licensing body as required by the state.
* CPR and de-escalation and restraint certification required (training available upon hire and offered by facility).
* First aid may be required based on state or facility

**WORK LOCATION:**

This position is onsite at the facility and is not a remote position.

**SUPERVISORY REQUIREMENTS:**

Two years’ supervisory/management experience in behavioral health preferred.

Why Highland Hospital?Highland Hospital offers a comprehensive benefit plan and a competitive salary commensurate with experience and qualifications. Qualified candidates should apply by submitting a resume. Highland Hospital is an EOE.

Veterans and military spouses are highly encouraged to apply. Summit BHC is dedicated to serving Veterans with specialized programming at our treatment centers across the country. We recognize and value the unique strengths of the military community in supporting our mission to serve those who have served.

As a quality manager you will ensure that the manufacturing site meets and applies the Global Quality Policies and Guidelines relating to, ISO 9001 & 13485 standards, FDA 21 CFR 820 regulations, customer requirements and comply with necessary local and international regulations.

**Essential Job Functions and Responsibilities****:**

* Responsible for , leading developing, implementing and manage an effective quality management systems that supports the company-wide quality policy, ISO 9000, ISO 13485 and FDA 21 CFR 820 regulations for medical devices with a continuous improvement programs.
* Lead, develop, implement and maintain quality systems for controlling product quality using process capability, inspection, auditing and statistical analysis.
* Lead, develop, implement and maintain an effective quality system for preventing nonconforming product and/or its recurrence using quality planning, material review, corrective action and quality reporting.
* Responsible for selection, interviewing and onboarding of new hires and develop a relevant training program and plan for all site personnel.
* Responsible for leading, driving and enforcing quality programs in collaboration with manufacturing team.
* Resolve customer concerns, complaints and provide feedback on quality issues.
* Analyze daily and monthly quality reports and develop tests to improve product quality.
* Manage day to day department activities.
* Support company quality policy and objectives.
* Ensure products produced meets customer expectations (approve quality specifications) and regulatory requirements
* Lead customer audits, ISO audits and Internal audits
* Achieve financial objectives (maintain department salaries within budget, prepare the Quality budget, schedule the expenditures)
* Follow and report of the site quality performances from a quality standpoint and ensure alignment with Business Unit and manage continuous improvement for product quality
* In cooperation with the Sites Quality Coordinator, develop and implement Quality Objectives in line with objectives of the business unit
* Lead and influence a quality mindset to quality and operations to maintain, improving and maintaining quality system requirements.
* Continually improve quality through analyzing, identifying, and eliminating root causes. Such improvements include reducing defects, decreasing scrap, reducing waste, and improving outputs.
* Apply and evaluate testing and inspection methods; including the identification of requirements for improvements.
* Develop and implement quality cost reduction concepts and techniques.
* Manage department resources, including work assignments, training, cross training, personnel issues, hiring decisions, performance appraisals, motivation, efficiency, capacity and accuracy of work.
* Ensure shift-to-shift communication.
* Provide a safe work environment and resolve any safety issues that arise.
* Perform other job-related duties as assigned.

**Core Competencies:**

* Facilitation
* Conflict Management
* Fostering Learning
* Information Gathering & Processing
* Interactive Communication
* Partnering
* Relationship Building
* Research
* Teamwork
* Writing Skills
* Attention to detail
* Adaptability
* Concern for Safety
* Proactive and self-motivated
* Strong time management with priority setting skills
* Client focused

**Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities**

* Expert knowledge and interpretation of ISO 13485, ISO 9000 standards, 21 CFR 820 and cGMP compliance.
* Ability to lead, implement quality management systems as applicable to ISO and 21 CFR regulations.
* Demonstrate understanding of industry standard validation tools and techniques.
* Demonstrated ability of metrology and basic inspection tools, metrology and injection molding workmanship standards.
* Ability to develop/conduct quality related training programs.
* Effectively communicate in both verbal and written.
* Good organizational skills.
* Excellent English communication skills (both written and verbal).
* Fluency in Spanish a plus.
* Understanding and use of metrology equipment.
* Ability to read drawings and good understanding of geometric tolerancing.
* Knowledge of processing engineering polymers is a plus.
* Exceptional leadership skills which include ability to prioritize, lead, direct, train, and motivate staff.
* Ability to influence peers.
* Excellent planning and organizational skills.
* Good analytical, problem-solving and math skills. Six Sigma and Lean knowledge a plus.
* Understanding and use of sampling plans, Gauge R&R, statistical techniques and SPC.
* Ability to use personal computer and Windows-based software (Outlook, Word and Excel preferred). Use of PC-DMIS metrology software, IQMS manufacturing software and Minitab a plus.

**Education and/or Experience**:

* Bachelor’s degree desirable, four-year college degree (preferably in a sciences chemical, pharmacy, plastics or engineering field) or equivalent combined college/work experience.
* At least 5 years of leading and implementing quality systems in a pharmaceutical or medical device environment
* Manufacturing experience in injection molding plastics industry (or equivalent industry) is a plus.

**Director of Quality Compliance** 
 **Southern Peaks, Canon City CO**
======================================================================

[Full-Time)

$75,000 To $90,000 Annually

DailyPay Available

**Looking for More Than Just a Job?**
-------------------------------------

At Abraxaswe believe every person deserves the opportunity to live a meaningful, fulfilling, and independent life.

We’re seeking compassionate, dedicated professionals who are looking for more than a paycheck. We’re looking for individuals who want to make a difference, build rewarding careers, and become part of a team committed to helping others succeed.

Whether you’re beginning your career, changing professions, or bringing years of experience, we provide the training, support, and opportunities needed to help you thrive.

**About Abraxas**
-----------------

For more than 50 years, Abraxas has been dedicated to improving lives through high-quality services and support.

Our employees play a vital role in helping individuals achieve greater independence, confidence, and success while promoting dignity, respect, inclusion, and personal choice.

Every day, our team members make a meaningful impact by supporting people in reaching their goals and living their best lives.

**Why Join Our Team?**
======================

**Competitive Pay & Benefits**
------------------------------

* Competitive Compensation
* DailyPay – Access Your Earned Wages Before Payday
* Medical, Dental & Vision Insurance
* 401(k) Retirement Plan
* Paid Time Off
* Employee Assistance Program
* Wellness Programs
* Employee Referral Bonuses
* Company-Paid Training

**Career Growth & Development**
-------------------------------

* Paid Training Programs
* Professional Development Opportunities
* Certification Opportunities
* Leadership Development Programs
* Career Advancement Opportunities
* Opportunities Across Multiple Service Lines

**Meaningful Work That Matters**
--------------------------------

* Make a Difference Every Day
* Support Individuals and Families
* Build Meaningful Relationships
* Strengthen Communities
* Join a Mission-Driven Organization

**What You’ll Do**
==================

As a Director of Quality Compliance, you will:

Monitors compliance with applicable Colorado Department of Human Services (CDHS) Volume 7 residential licensing rules, including 12 CCR 2509-8, Section 7.714, as well as payer and Joint Commission requirements.

* Works with program leaders to draft corrective action plans for Director review and approval. Tracks deadlines, verifies completion, and escalates overdue or ineffective actions.
* Coordinates preparation for licensing inspections, payer reviews, and accreditation surveys. Organizes evidence and tracks follow-up requests.
* Tracks updates to Health First Colorado (Colorado Medicaid) and Regional Accountable Entity (RAE) requirements and works with program leaders to update procedures and audit tools.
* Conducts chart and program audits covering intake, assessments, treatment planning, service documentation, and discharge planning. Shares findings and conducts follow-up audits.
* Supervises assigned Quality and Compliance staff, coordinates audit assignments, and coaches staff on applying regulatory, payer, and accreditation standards.
* Maintains monitoring tools and trains program staff on policy changes, documentation expectations, and recurring audit findings.
* Analyzes audit results, incidents, grievances, clinical outcomes, and authorization and denial trends. Reports results to program leadership and the Director and tracks improvement actions.
* Partners with Clinical, Admissions, and Billing to monitor prior authorization, concurrent and continued-stay review, and documentation of medical necessity and level of care. Tracks denials and appeals.
* Drafts and updates procedures for Director review. Maintains current policy manuals and tracks required staff education.
* Prepares compliance reports and supporting records for leadership and board review.
* Coordinates documentation and follow-up for annual licensed independent practitioner peer review at Joint Commission accredited programs.
* Supports PREA training, audit preparation, and corrective action follow-up for assigned programs where applicable.
* Participates in quality and compliance committees and follows up on assigned actions.
* Performs other duties as assigned

**Who We’re Looking For**
=========================

You may be a great fit if you are:

✔ Compassionate

✔ Dependable

✔ Patient

✔ Team-Oriented

✔ Service-Focused

✔ Professional

✔ Positive

✔ Committed to Helping Others

**Qualifications**
==================

Required:

Bachelor's degree in social sciences, healthcare, behavioral health or related field and five years related experience OR Master’s degree and three years of experience.

* Knowledge of Colorado Volume 7 residential licensing requirements, Health First Colorado behavioral health managed care, and applicable accreditation standards is required.
* Experience with behavioral health utilization management, including authorization, medical necessity and continued-stay documentation, and payer audits. Experience in youth residential mental health or psychiatric residential treatment facilities (PRTFs) is preferred.
* Experience with Prison Rape Elimination Act (PREA) compliance, including staff training, audit preparation, and corrective action follow-up, is preferred.
* Ability to supervise and coach staff, assign work, and follow up on performance expectations.
* Ability to develop and teach methods for auditing, monitoring, and improving program operations.
* Ability to interpret and teach the application of regulations, payer requirements, accreditation standards, and contractual language.
* Knowledge of adolescent residential mental health treatment, including trauma-informed care, co-occurring conditions, and the needs of youth involved in child welfare or juvenile justice.
* Ability to develop and revise policies that meet licensing, payer, contractual, and accreditation requirements.
* Ability to communicate effectively, both orally and in written form, with a diverse group of people including regulatory agency representatives, employees, clients, governing body members, and the general public.
* Must be available for periodic travel, to include overnight stays.
* Must have a valid driver’s license.
* Ability to work with computers and the necessary software typically used by the department.

**Physical Requirements (If Applicable)**
=========================================

* Ability to lift up to 25 pounds
* Ability to stand, walk, bend, and assist individuals as needed
* Ability to perform essential job functions with or without reasonable accommodation

**Apply Today**
===============

Some jobs pay the bills. Some jobs build careers. This job changes lives.

If you’re looking for meaningful work where your compassion, dedication, and hard work make a real difference every day, we encourage you to apply today.

**Join our team and become the reason someone has a better day.**

### **About Our Organization**

**Abraxas** is part of the Inperium family of companies.

Employment for this position is administered through Apis Services, Inc.

### **Equal Opportunity Employer**

Apis Services, Inc., Inperium Inc., and affiliates provide equal employment opportunities for all employees and applicants for employment in compliance with all federal and applicable state and local laws and regulations, including nondiscrimination in hiring and employment.

All employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, ancestry, age, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, disability, genetic information, marital status, pregnancy, childbirth, veteran status, or any other status protected by law.

This policy of nondiscrimination and equal employment opportunity extends to every phase and aspect of hiring and employment

new_roles.title: Director of Quality, Regulatory & Improvement
new_roles.description:
***Title:*** ***Director of Quality, Regulatory and Improvement***

**Job Summary:**
----------------

This senior leadership role leads the quality departments for all Deringer-Ney locations globally. The Director implements best practices and metrics to coordinate all teams under a unified Quality Management System and is responsible for ensuring that the company's products, services, and manufacturing processes comply with strict government laws, industry standards, and internal quality systems. The role plans, coordinates, and directs the activities of the quality assurance and compliance programs to ensure the production of consistent, reliable products that meet or exceed established standards, and leads the continuous improvement team to support, train, and execute the DNIOS system.

***Supervisory Responsibilities:****Yes*

**Duties/Responsibilities:**
----------------------------

* Manage all quality departments by formulating, developing, and overseeing global goals, objectives, policies, procedures, systems, and outcomes pertaining to quality controls, assessments, and audits.
* Quality Management Systems (QMS): Build, maintain, and continuously improve QMS frameworks (such as ISO 13485 and ISO 9001).
* Develop a high-performance team by acquiring, developing, training, coaching, cultivating, and managing talented Quality Control personnel.
* Maintain and improve the quality system through routine system audits and corrective actions, and ensure that corrective actions, whether internal or external, are handled in a timely manner.
* Risk & Lifecycle Management: Oversee design controls, validation packages, complaint handling, and post-market surveillance (such as Automotive Reporting).
* Manage and maintain quality inspection and product release programs for raw materials, work in process (WIP), and finished goods.
* Regulatory Compliance & Filings: Lead product submissions and act as the primary liaison during agency audits.
* Disseminate quality awareness, adherence, and developments to global stakeholders by scheduling and performing regional quality audits and by ensuring that ISO systems are managed and maintained.
* Serve as an active member of the DNI Leadership Team, sharing the function's progress toward its goals while setting, and driving toward, an aspirational vision for a best-in-class quality department.
* Create a Cost of Poor Quality metric for the organization and set specific goals to improve quality performance across the company.
* Lead the development of the Annual Strategic Planning (P.D.C.A.) Cycle to include the Improvement Process.
* Lead the organization in attaining key metrics based on Balanced Scorecard (BSC) Objectives. Understand the department's key performance indicators and leading and lagging indicators, and contribute to achieving these goals, both individually and as a team.
* With the CIP Team, perform systematic audits designed to confirm that process standards are being utilized and met (BSC One-Page Reports).
* Interact with and make recommendations and presentations to the Executive Leadership Group via standardized checks: weekly, monthly, quarterly, and year-end. Maintain the PDCA Cycle while focusing on BSC Objectives.

**Required Skills/Abilities:**
------------------------------

* Strong background in ISO 9000 system management, including training and auditing.
* Strong background in ISO 13485 system management and thorough knowledge of FDA requirements and other international standards that regulate the medical device industry.
* Knowledge of automated inspection equipment, including vision systems and coordinate measuring devices.
* Adept at delegating and managing multiple tasks with various levels of priority.
* Excellent communication skills; must be able to present ideas, results, and requirements effectively throughout the organization and to the customer on a timely basis.
* Expert skill set in applied statistics, reliability, design of experiments, MSA, GR&R, and project management.
* Fluency with various software packages commonly used in project management, database, SPC, word processing, and data acquisition.
* Analytical, problem-solving, project management, facilitation, and decision-making skills are essential.
* Strong leadership skills with the ability to motivate, coach, resolve conflict, and promote teamwork.
* Ability to see and hear the facts from several viewpoints while promoting success through interactive problem solving and teamwork.

**Experience & Education Requirements:**
----------------------------------------

* Technical degree (BS, BSE, or BSME) with a minimum of 10 years' experience in quality engineering or quality management.
* Strong preference for relevant industry experience in a metals or electrical connectors company or similar.
* 10+ years of progressive experience in Quality Assurance, Quality Control, or Regulatory Affairs within a regulated field such as medical devices, automotive, or defense.
* Preferred certifications: Regulatory Affairs Certification (RAC), Certified Quality Auditor (CQA), or Certified Quality Engineer (CQE).
* Demonstrated project management skills in the areas of process control, SPC, automotive PPAP submission, and statistical analysis.
* Lean Green Belt or Black Belt certification, Six Sigma, and DMAIC process experience.
* Actively continuing training through courses and seminars.

***Physical Requirements:***

* Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer.
* Must be able to lift 15 pounds at times.
* Must be able to access and navigate each department at the organization’s facilities.
* Travel to other locations as required.

new_roles.title: Director, Quality Engineering
new_roles.description:
HHAeXchange is the leading technology platform for home and community-based care. Founded in 2008, HHAeXchange was born out of an idea to create a fully comprehensive end-to-end homecare solution to help people who are aging or have disabilities thrive in their homes and communities. Our employees are passionate about transforming the healthcare space by building the only homecare ecosystem that fully connects patients, personal care providers, managed care organizations, and states.

The Director, Quality Engineering will lead the enterprise-wide quality strategy and Quality Assurance (QA) program across HHAeXchange. This role is responsible for standardizing testing processes and tools, driving test automation, and ensuring our products meet high standards for reliability, performance, security, and accessibility. The Director, Quality Engineering will oversee functional and non-functional testing practices, including accessibility (WCAG) and security-related validation, and will own processes that support customer User Acceptance Testing (UAT).

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential job duty satisfactorily. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

**This is a fully remote opportunity for candidates located in the EST or CST time zones within the US only.**

### **Essential Job Duties**

* **Enterprise Quality Leadership:** Develop, implement, and lead the overall quality strategy and QA operating model across the organization.
* **Standardize Testing Processes:** Define and enforce consistent testing approaches including test planning, test cases, regression strategy, and release readiness criteria.
* **Tooling Ownership:** Select, implement, and manage enterprise testing tools for test management, automation, performance, accessibility, and security validation.
* **Automation Strategy:** Drive increased automated test coverage across UI, API, mobile, and services, reducing reliance on manual regression testing.
* **Compliance, Accessibility & VPAT Reporting:**
 + Lead accessibility testing programs aligned to WCAG 2.1+
 + Oversee creation and maintenance of Voluntary Product Accessibility Templates (VPATs) and Accessibility Conformance Reports
 + Partner with Product, Legal, and Compliance to respond to customer accessibility requirements and audits
* **Security & Compliance Testing Support:** Coordinate with Security teams on SAST/DAST, vulnerability validation, and remediation tracking.
* **Customer UAT Support:**
 + Define and support customer UAT strategies and environments
 + Provide test plans, data guidance, and defect triage support during customer acceptance testing cycles
 + Ensure feedback from UAT informs release decisions and product quality improvements
* **Quality Metrics & Reporting:** Establish KPIs to measure product quality, defect escape rate, automation coverage, UAT outcomes, and release readiness; communicate results to leadership.
* **Shift-Left Quality Practices:** Embed quality earlier in the development lifecycle through collaboration on requirements, acceptance criteria, and CI/CD integration.
* **Incident & Defect Management:** Oversee defect triage for high-priority production and pre-production issues and ensure timely resolution and root-cause prevention.
* **Cross-Functional Collaboration:** Work closely with Product Management, Engineering, DevOps, Security, and Compliance to ensure alignment of quality practices across releases.
* **Organizational Leadership**: Build, mentor, and lead a high-performing team of QA engineers, SDETs, automation engineers, and accessibility/compliance testers.
* **Continuous Improvement:** Identify quality gaps and drive process improvements that improve product reliability, reduce rework, and increase delivery confidence.
* **Release Governance:** Participate in release readiness reviews and serve as a key stakeholder in go/no-go decisions.
* **Coding agent advocacy:** **Help onboard team members to AI development tools. Share techniques, prompt patterns, and review practices that make AI-augmented development effective and safe in a regulated environment.**

### **Other Job Duties**

* Other duties as assigned by supervisor or HHAeXchange leader.

### **Travel Requirements**

* Travel up to 10%, including overnight travel

### **Required Education, Experience, Certifications and Skills**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field required.
* 10+ years of experience in software engineering within a software product company, with a focus on developing scalable, high-performance systems.
* 4+ years leading QA organizations or enterprise quality programs.
* Proven experience designing and implementing standardized QA processes and test automation strategies in SaaS environments.
* Hands-on experience implementing automated testing frameworks integrated into CI/CD pipelines.
* Experience with accessibility testing and standards such as WCAG 2.1+ and authoring VPATs/ACRs.
* Experience supporting security testing practices such as vulnerability scanning, SAST/DAST, and penetration test remediation validation.
* Experience supporting or running customer UAT processes.
* Strong understanding of quality metrics (defect rates, coverage, MTTR, escape rate, etc.) and how to operationalize them.
* Background working in cloud-based architectures and microservices environments.
* Demonstrated success collaborating across engineering, product, and security teams in a fast-paced environment.
* Strong leadership skills with experience managing and developing QA and automation teams.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to communicate complex topics to technical and non-technical partners.
* **AI/ML fundamentals:** Familiarity with LLM APIs, prompt engineering, and how generative AI can be applied in a product context. Direct project experience preferred.

The base salary range for this US-based, full-time, and exempt position is $175,000-195,000/yr, not including variable compensation. An employee’s exact starting salary will be based on various factors including but not limited to experience, education, training, merit, location, and the ability to exemplify the HHAeXchange core values.

This is a benefits-eligible position. HHAeXchange offers competitive health plans, paid time-off, company paid holidays, 401K retirement program with a Company elected match, including other company sponsored programs.

HHAeXchange is an equal-opportunity employer. The Company offers employment opportunities to all applicants and employees without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, medical condition, marital status, veteran status, citizenship, genetic information, hairstyles, or any other status protected by local or federal law.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

new_roles.title: Director of Quality Assurance
new_roles.description:
Karman Space & Defense is a leader in the rapid design, development, and production of critical, next-generation system solutions that align with the U.S. Department of War and its allies' core mission priorities, and meet the accelerating demand for access to space. Building on nearly 50 years of success, we deliver Payload & Protection Systems, Aero/Hydrodynamic Interstage Systems, and Propulsion & Launch Systems to more than 80 prime contractors supporting over 130 space and defense programs.

The Director of Quality, Defense is responsible for overseeing all quality activities, personnel, systems, and performance associated with Defense programs across multiple Karman Space & Defense operating sites. This role provides strategic and operational leadership to ensure all Defense hardware, assemblies, and services meet or exceed contractual, regulatory, and customer requirements. 
 
This position will manage the Defense Quality Engineering organization, supports execution of Defense programs, and ensures consistent application of quality standards and tools across the sector. This leader works in close partnership with the Enterprise Director of Quality to align each site's AS9100 compliant QMS with the emerging enterprise quality architecture and to transition multiple Defense sites toward a unified enterprise certification. 
 
This role is critical in driving disciplined execution, continuous improvement, product integrity, and customer satisfaction within the Defense market segment.

Reports to Vice President, Defense. Functional Partnership with Enterprise Director of Quality (Karman Space & Defense). 
 
**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES** 

* Lead, develop, and manage the Quality Engineering team supporting all Defense programs and projects.
* Build a culture of accountability, collaboration, proactive risk management, and continuous improvement across Defense Quality functions.
* Serve as the primary Defense quality leader to the VP of Defense and the Defense leadership team.
* Ensure the quality of all Defense hardware, assemblies, engineered systems, and services produced across multiple sites.
* Oversee program quality planning, including inspection strategies, qualification/verification plans, critical characteristics control, product safety considerations, and risk mitigation.
* Review and approve quality requirements for Defense proposals, contracts, and manufacturing plans.
* Drive effective root cause analysis, corrective action, and failure review processes for Defense programs.
* Ensure each Defense site maintains compliance to AS9100, customer requirements, and regulatory obligations.
* Provide direct guidance to site Quality Managers/Quality Engineers on QMS implementation, audit readiness, and procedural improvement.
* Support site internal audits, customer audits, DCMA oversight, and third‑party certification audits.
* Partner with the Enterprise Director of Quality to align Defense site QMS structures, documentation, and practices with the enterprise quality framework.
* Support the long-term strategy to transition multiple Defense AS9100 certificates into a unified enterprise certificate.
* Collaborate closely on enterprise initiatives such as configuration management improvements, risk management systems, document control harmonization, supplier quality strategies, and enterprise metrics.

 
**EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE** 

* Bachelor's degree in engineering, Quality, Manufacturing, or related technical field preferred
* 10 years of experience in aerospace/defense quality roles preferred.
* Strong working knowledge of AS9100, ISO 9001, and Defense customer quality standards.
* Quality Engineering experience with complex programs including design.

**ITAR REQUIREMENTS**

To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, certain positions may require applicants to be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State.

**TRAVEL REQUIREMENTS**

Occasional travel 0-10% of the time.

Karman Space and Defense is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status, or any other status protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

View our Privacy Policy

new_roles.title: Senior Director, Product Quality
new_roles.description:
»

**Date:** Nov 12, 2026

**Location:** North Reading, MA, US

**Company:** Teradyne

We are the global test and automation specialists, powering next-generation technologies through sophisticated solutions. Behind every electronic device you use, Teradyne's test technology ensures your device works right the first time, every time! Our portfolio of automation solutions help manufacturers to develop and deliver products quickly, efficiently and cost-effectively. Together, Teradyne companies deliver manufacturing automation across industries and applications around the world!

 

We attract, develop, and retain a high-performance workforce, comprised of people with diverse backgrounds and a shared drive for excellence. We strive to foster a positive and inclusive work environment that helps employees, and communities, thrive.

**Our Purpose**

TERADYNE, where experience meets innovation and driving excellence in every connection. We are fueled by creativity and diversity of thought and in our workforce. Our employees are supported to innovate and learn something new every day.

We cultivate a culture of inclusion for all employees that respects their individual strengths, views, and experiences. We believe that our differences enable us to be a better team – one that makes better decisions, drives innovation and delivers better business results.

 

**Opportunity Overview**

The Senior Director, Product Quality & Customer Excellence owns customer-perceived quality for Teradyne’s Compute Test Division, from design through the field. Reporting to the division’s VP of Engineering, this high-visibility role leads Software Quality Engineering and drives quality across hardware, software, FPGA, ASIC, applications, manufacturing, and service engineering. You will work with our executive team and largest customers to build the quality organization and reputation of the division.

* Lead customer escalations from first call to closure, driving Severity 1 and 2 escalations down 20 to 30% every year.
* Develop design reviews, risk analysis, and release gates that engineering respects and that stop a bad release.
* Collaborate with engineering leaders across organizations you do not manage, earning their commitment through credibility, data, and follow-through.
* Build trusted relationships with top customers, and cut field defect escapes every year while shipping every major launch clean through its first six months.
* Partner with leadership to show the cost of poor quality and the margin benefit of reducing it, and close more than 95% of corrective actions on time.
* Mentor and retain exceptional quality engineers, and develop the next generation of quality leaders.
 

**All About You**

We seek individuals who share our passion and determination. Our commitment to customer success drives us to go the extra mile. If you’re ready to join us in this mission, take a closer look at the minimum criteria for the position.

* BS in Software Engineering or a related field, or equivalent experience (MS a plus)
* Typically 15+ years in quality, engineering, product development, or applications, including 10+ years leading cross-functional teams on complex technical products
* A measured, visible quality turnaround or product launch you can point to
* Strong command of product development, verification and validation, reliability, and field operations
* Proven success building and leading teams, including managers
* Direct experience working with executive-level customers
* Ability to take a big, ambiguous, high-stakes problem and drive it to done without waiting to be pushed
* Accountability for outcomes, not activity: you set targets publicly, then hit them or own the miss, and you tell the truth early
* A customer-first mindset, leading and influencing across organizations by earning commitment
* Preferred: experience in semiconductor test equipment (ATE), test and measurement, capital equipment, networking, or enterprise infrastructure
* Preferred: product quality leadership in mission critical, complex hardware and software systems
* Preferred: a track record of using AI, automation, and data to measurably speed up root-cause analysis and problem closure
 

If this role excites you but your background does not match every bullet above, we would still love to hear from you.

 

*We are only considering candidates local to position location and are unable to provide relocation for this position.*

*This position is not eligible for visa sponsorship.*

 

**Compensation:**
 
The base salary range for this role is $228,200 - $365,100. This range is a good faith estimate, and the amount of base salary will correspond with experience and skill set. This range can also fluctuate depending on demand and location.

**Incentive Plan:** This job is eligible for discretionary bonus(es) based on financial performance.

 

**Benefits:**
 
Teradyne offers a variety of robust health and well-being benefit programs, including medical, dental, vision, Flexible Spending Accounts, retirement savings plans, life and disability insurance, paid vacation & holidays, tuition assistance programs, and more.

 

#LI-KD

 

**Job Segment:** Senior Quality Engineer, Testing, Product Development, Test Engineer, Manager, Engineering, Technology, Research, Management

new_roles.title: Director of Quality
new_roles.description:
Job Summary:

### **Position Summary**

The Director of Quality is an execution-focused leader responsible for translating WellBe’s enterprise quality strategy into disciplined, measurable operations across markets and health plan contracts.

This role leads the day-to-day Quality function, manages and develops team members, and redesigns care-gap closure workflows to be simpler, standardized, scalable, and integrated into clinical practice.

The Director partners closely with market, clinical, pharmacy, analytics, technology, coding, and health plan stakeholders to improve HEDIS and Medicare Advantage Stars performance, strengthen data reliability, increase frontline accountability, and ensure the organization consistently converts quality insights into action.

Job Description:

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities** 
Lead day-to-day execution of the Quality program across Part C and Part D, converting enterprise goals into clear workplans, owners, timelines, operating rhythms, and measurable results. 
Directly manage, coach, and performance-manage Quality team members; establish clear productivity, quality, service, and accountability standards. 
Map end-to-end care-gap closure workflows across measures, markets, and health plan contracts; identify handoffs, rework, manual steps, failure points, and unnecessary variation. 
Redesign and standardize workflows so care-gap identification, outreach, documentation, closure, submission, and reconciliation are consistently executed and sustainable at scale. 
Engage Markets using structured working sessions that diagnose barriers, assign actions, monitor commitments, and drive closure at the patient, provider, measure, and market levels. 
Partner with clinical operations and technology teams to surface prioritized care gaps at the point of care and embed closure activities into APP workflows. 
Lead implementation and adoption of Quality workflow tools, including in-house technologies, point-of-care solutions, telephony or workforce-management tools, and future AI-enabled capabilities. 
Oversee HEDIS chart abstraction, primary source validation, medical record retrieval, supplemental data submissions, and health plan audit support, with an emphasis on accuracy, timeliness, and reduced manual effort. 
Manage medication adherence and other Part D outreach operations; use performance and workflow data to improve productivity, assess capacity, and inform staffing decisions. 
Partner with analytics, IT, and health plan teams to strengthen WellBe-owned quality reporting using claims, EMR, pharmacy, and supplemental data; reconcile numerator, denominator, timing, and data-integrity differences. 
Use market-, provider-, measure-, and patient-level data to prioritize interventions, forecast performance, monitor outcomes, and adjust tactics quickly when results are off track. 
Evaluate and implement practical automation and AI-assisted solutions that reduce repetitive work, improve chart-review efficiency, and allow the team to focus on higher-value intervention and market partnership. 
Own point-of-care solution assessment and implementation, including identification of operational pain points, vendor coordination, rollout planning, training, adoption, and performance monitoring. 
Maintain current knowledge of NCQA, HEDIS, CMS, Stars, and applicable health plan requirements; ensure workflows, documentation, submissions, and controls remain compliant. 
Build effective cross-functional relationships and drive decisions with stakeholders across clinical operations, pharmacy, coding, analytics, technology, finance, compliance, markets, and external vendors.

Job Requirements:

### **Required Qualifications**

**Education:** Bachelor’s degree in nursing, healthcare administration, public health, health sciences, business, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.

**Experience:** Seven or more years of progressive experience in healthcare quality, managed care, provider operations, population health, HEDIS, or Medicare Advantage Stars, including 3–5 years of people-management experience. Demonstrated experience setting expectations, coaching team members, managing performance, delivering measurable operational results, and mapping, redesigning, implementing, and sustaining complex workflows across multiple teams, markets, or contracts.

**Skills:** Strong working knowledge of NCQA HEDIS specifications, Medicare Advantage Stars, care-gap closure, medical record review, supplemental data, and quality operations. Proven ability to move between strategy and execution, manage multiple priorities, remove barriers, and deliver results in a fast-paced, matrixed organization. Strong people leadership, change-management, project-management, process-improvement, problem-solving, and written and verbal communication skills. Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Excel and presentation tools; experience with workflow platforms, reporting tools, automation, or AI-enabled healthcare solutions preferred. High attention to detail, sound judgment, and the ability to maintain confidentiality.

### **Physical and Mental Requirements**

* Ability to stand or sit for extended periods.
* Visual acuity and fine motor.
* Ability to travel locally or nationally as needed.

### **Work Environment**

This role operates in a corporate, primarily remote environment and requires frequent collaboration across functions, markets, and external partners. Occasional travel and schedule flexibility may be required to support market operations, implementations, audits, and business priorities. No routine on-call responsibilities are expected.

### **Sponsorship Statement**

WellBe does not offer employment-based visa sponsorship for this position. Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship now or in the future.

### **Pay Transparency Statement**

Compensation for this position will be disclosed in accordance with applicable state and local pay transparency laws.

### **Safety-Sensitive Statement**

This position has been designated as safety-sensitive. As such, the employee must be able to perform job duties in a manner that ensures the safety of themselves, coworkers, patients, and the public. The role requires full cognitive and physical functioning at all times.

Employees in safety-sensitive positions are subject to drug and alcohol testing, including for substances that may impair judgment or motor function, in accordance with applicable federal and state laws and company policy. Due to the safety-sensitive nature of this role and in alignment with federal law and workplace safety standards, the use of marijuana—including medical or recreational use—is prohibited. WellBe Senior Medical will comply with applicable state laws regarding medical marijuana and reasonable accommodations, where such laws do not conflict with safety requirements or federal regulations.

### **Drug Screening Requirement**

As a condition of employment, WellBe Senior Medical requires all candidates to successfully complete a pre-employment drug screening. Ongoing employment may also be contingent upon compliance with the company’s Drug-Free Workplace Policy, which includes random, post-accident, and reasonable suspicion drug testing. The company reserves the right to test for substances that may impair an employee’s ability to safely and effectively perform their job duties.

### **Background Check Statement**

Employment is contingent upon successful completion of a background check, as permitted by law. As a healthcare organization, WellBe conducts monthly FACIS (Fraud and Abuse Control Information System) checks on all employees. Continued employment is contingent upon satisfactory results of these checks, in accordance with applicable laws and regulations.

### **Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) Statement**

WellBe is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other legally protected status.

### **Americans with Disabilities Act**

WellBe Senior Medical is committed to complying with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) and applicable state and local laws. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the job. If you require an accommodation during the application, interview or employment process, please contact Human Resources at HRPeopleLine@wellbe.com

### **At-Will Employment Statement**

Employment with WellBe is at-will unless otherwise specified by contract. This job description does not constitute an employment contract.

### **Disclaimer**

This job description is intended to describe the general nature and level of work performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, and skills required. Management reserves the right to modify, add, or remove duties as necessary.

new_roles.title: Quality Director
new_roles.description:
**Build Your Career. Lead With Precision.**

Nammo Perry is a center of excellence for the design, development and production of munitions and pyrotechnic products for the U.S. Department of Defense. Nammo employees working at the Florida site manufacture all types of 40mm low and high velocity ammunition; pyrotechnic marking; signaling and tactical illumination devices; battlefield effects training simulators; demolition charges; hand grenade fuzes; and other ammunition components. Additionally, they provide load, assemble, and pack (LAP) services for large caliber direct-fire ammunition.

The **Director of Quality** provides strategic leadership and oversight of quality assurance, quality systems, supplier quality, and configuration management across Nammo Perry supporting the Large Caliber Systems and Aerospace Propulsion business units. Reporting to the President/General Manager, this position leads a multidisciplinary quality organization through four direct-report management functions: Configuration Management, Supplier Quality, Manufacturing Quality Systems, and Quality Assurance. These functions collectively support supplier compliance, product conformity, manufacturing qualities, inspection and testing, calibration, customer quality, and configuration controls.

The Director is accountable for establishing and maintaining a robust quality management system (QMS), ensuring compliance with customer, regulatory, and industry requirements, and driving continuous improvement throughout the organization. A key strategic priority is leading the site's transformation from ISO9001 certification to AS9100 certification encompassing both business units under one unified quality management system, as well as a robust supplier quality program.

**Unique Benefits Designed with Care**

* Monday - Thursday work week working 10-hour days
* Relocation assistance provided
* 401(K) with a 6% company match
* 100% Employer-Paid Employee Only Medical Plan Option
* Employer Health Saving Account Contributions
* Two week’s vacation, one-week sick pay, and nine paid holidays

**What You’ll Do: Precision in Action**

**Strategic Quality Leadership**

* Develop and execute quality strategies aligned with organizational objectives, customer requirements, regulatory expectations, and long-term business growth.
* Provide leadership and accountability across configuration management, supplier quality systems, and quality assurance ensuring consistent quality standards across both business units.
* Monitor key performance indicators related to product conformity, supplier performance, customer satisfaction, cost of poor quality, and continuous improvement.
* Partner with site leadership to evaluate quality risks, organizational capabilities, resource allocation, and strategic improvement opportunities.

**Quality Management Systems**

* Maintain compliance with existing ISO9001 and AS9100requirements while continuing to foster an environment of continuous improvement.
* Provides strategic oversight of the Quality Systems Organization including internal audits, corrective and preventative actions, document control, calibration, and customer quality activities.
* Ensure effective management review processes, regulatory and customer audit readiness, and continuous improvement of quality systems and organizational performance.

**Supplier Quality and Configuration Management**

* Provide strategic oversight of Supplier Quality including supplier qualification, performance monitoring and auditing, incoming inspection, and supplier corrective action processes.
* Ensure supplier quality engineering and receiving inspection activities support material conformity traceability and manufacturing readiness
* Lead Configuration Management functions to ensure appropriate control of product configuration, engineering changes, technical documentation, and applicable customer requirements through the established configuration management and business systems.
* Partner with supply chain engineering and operations to manage supplier risk, resolve quality concerns, and maintain effective configuration and product controls.

**Manufacturing Quality Assurance and Testing**

* Provide leadership and oversight of the Quality Assurance organization supporting manufacturing quality, engineering inspection, and testing activities across both business units.
* Support integrated product teams by offer subject expertise, ensuring programmatic needs are met
* Ensure effective execution of product inspection verification testing and acceptance processes in accordance with applicable specifications and customer requirements.
* Oversee quality assurance capabilities including quality technicians, testing personnel, and specialized inspection activities.
* Drive continuous improvement throughout the organization using established lean six sigma tools.
* Partner with operations and engineering to address manufacturing nonconformances, implement corrective action, and improve process capability and product reliability.

**Compliance, Financial Performance, and People Leadership**

* Ensure compliance with applicable aerospace and defense quality standards, contractual requirements, customer specifications, and regulatory obligations.
* Develop and maintain quality budgets, departmental resources, and improvement initiatives while promoting cost effectiveness and operational efficiency.
* Lead, coach, and develop direct-report managers while establishing clear expectations for performance accountability and organizational effectiveness
* Partner with people and culture on workforce planning succession planning leadership development and employee engagement.

**What Dedicated Teammates Bring**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Quality Management, Manufacturing, or related technical field. Equivalent combination of education and relevant experience may be considered.
* Minimum of 10 years of progressively responsible experience in quality assurance, quality engineering, quality systems, or quality leadership within a manufacturing environment.
* Minimum of 5 years of management experience including demonstrated success leading managers or multidisciplinary quality teams.
* Experience in aerospace defense, energetic materials, or other highly regulated manufacturing environments.
* Demonstrated experience implementing, maintaining, or leading quality management systems aligned with ISO9001 and AS9100 requirements.
* Strong understanding of manufacturing, quality supplier, quality configuration management, inspection, testing, and regulatory compliance.
* Proven ability to develop quality strategies, manage budgets, lead organizational change, and drive measurable performance improvements.
* Strong leadership communication, analytical, problem solving, and cross-functional collaboration skills.

*Preferred Qualifications:*

* Advanced degree in Engineering, Quality Management, Business Administration, or related discipline.
* Direct experience in defense manufacturing, energetic material processing, ammunition production, or aerospace propulsion.
* Demonstrated experience leading an organization through initial AS9100 certification or significant QMS expansion.
* Professional certifications such as ASQ Certified Manager of Quality/Organizational Excellence (CMQ/OE), Certified Quality Engineer (CQE) or Certified Quality Auditor (CQA).
* Experience with specialized inspection and testing methods, non-destructive testing, and manufacturing process qualifications.
* Knowledge of Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, root cause analysis, and structured continuous improvement methodologies.

*Leadership Competencies:*

* Aligns operational capabilities and resources with business objectives and long-term growth.
* Drives performance improvements in safety, quality, delivery cost, and reliability.
* Build strong management teams and promotes accountability, engagement, and succession readiness.
* Demonstrate sound judgment, hazard awareness, and commitment to disciplined operations,
* Build effective partnerships across departments and business units
* Leads teams through expansion, organizational growth, and evolving operational requirements.

**Our Woking Conditions and Requirements**

* This position operates in both office and industrial manufacturing environments and requires regular interaction with production areas, maintenance, operations, and facility infrastructure.
* The role may involve prolonged periods of sitting, standing, and walking, including navigating manufacturing facilities and operational work areas.
* Employees must comply with applicable safety, security, and environmental requirements including the use of required personal protective equipment (PPE) when entering designated areas.
* The position may require occasional domestic or international travel and flexibility to support operational needs outside standard business hours.
* Must be able to perform the essential functions of the position with or without reasonable accommodation.

*Our values are the fundamental principles guiding the way we do business and interact with stakeholders.*

***DEDICATION:*** *We are enthusiastic and creative, always searching for the best solutions.* 
***PRECISION:*** *We are reliable and accurate in our technology, processes and business.* 
***CARE:*** *We are inclusive and open-minded, always encouraging team spirit and cooperation.*

*Nammo and its subsidiaries provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.*

*This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation and training.*

**\*\*Note\*\*: Due to US Export Control laws and regulations; applicants selected for employment must show proof of a U.S. Person status before employment may begin.**
