new_roles.title: Director Operational Excellence
new_roles.description:
**Build Your Career with Ashley Furniture- Where Innovation Meets Comfort**

**Who We Are:**

At Ashley, inspiring the love of home is at the heart of everything we do. As the world’s largest manufacturer of home furnishings, we’re more than a business — we’re a family driven by innovation, competitiveness, and an unwavering commitment to excellence. We persevere through challenges, push beyond the status quo, and constantly seek better ways to deliver an exceptional customer experience. Our solutions-first mindset and dedication to growth are why Ashley remains #1 in our industry.

If you’re ready to grow, you’ve come to the right place. With a true “Growth Mindset,” Ashley Furniture invests in developing future leaders and helps every team member learn from the best in the business.

 

**If you are a current Ashley employee**: Please login to your UKG account and apply using the internal job board.

 

**Summary:**

The Ashley Home Delivery (AHD) Operational Excellence Director provides centralized leadership for operational planning, routing, process development, project execution, vendor governance, performance management, and organizational coordination across Ashley Home Delivery. This role translates strategy into repeatable operating standards, disciplined execution, measurable performance, and scalable support.

The Director partners with field leadership and cross-functional teams to improve customer experience, delivery performance, carrier accountability, cost effectiveness, and launch readiness, enabling Regional Directors and market leaders to remain focused on field execution.

**Responsibilities:**

**Operational Planning & Routing**

* Lead the centralized routing organization, establishing operating rhythms, service standards, workload allocation, escalation paths, and accountability.
* Own delivery forecasting, capacity planning, route-planning governance, and resource alignment across AHD markets.
* Develop, document, deploy, and audit routing standards that support safe, efficient, reliable, and customer-focused delivery execution.
* Partner with field leaders to identify capacity constraints, route-quality issues, and execution risks, coordinating corrective actions as needed.

**Operational Excellence**

* Lead the development, maintenance, communication, and adoption of standard operating procedures across Ashley Home Delivery.
* Design and continuously improve end-to-end processes for stand-up, load-out, route monitoring, check-in, returns, recovery, beginning-of-day controls, and end-of-day controls.
* Develop validation, compliance, and audit tools to ensure operating standards are understood, adopted, and sustained.
* Drive continuous improvement through data analysis, root-cause analysis, structured problem-solving, and field feedback.
* Establish governance and documentation processes that preserve institutional knowledge and keep operating standards current.

**3PL & Vendor Management**

* Lead carrier sourcing, due diligence, onboarding, implementation, and performance governance in partnership with Procurement, Legal, Finance, Risk, and AHD leadership.
* Establish consistent business reviews, escalation processes, relationship-management routines, and service expectations for delivery partners.
* Provide leadership for the AHD Claims team and governance of claims administration, disputes, documentation, approval controls, and timely resolution.
* Oversee invoice validation and payment-administration processes, including controls that support accuracy, transparency, and accountability.
* Support contract improvements and ensure approved terms, service levels, and operating requirements are effectively implemented.

**Performance Management**

* Develop and maintain national AHD KPI definitions, reporting standards, scorecards, forecasts, and performance dashboards.
* Establish management routines connecting daily operating controls, weekly business reviews, action plans, and executive-level visibility.
* Analyze performance trends and operational gaps, identify root causes, establish accountable owners, and track corrective actions through resolution.
* Provide decision-ready reporting on customer experience, delivery reliability, productivity, capacity, cost, claims, and carrier performance.

**Strategic Projects & Launch Execution**

* Lead program and project management for AHD market launches, conversions, expansions, and national operational initiatives.
* Establish launch-readiness plans covering schedules, staffing, training, travel, uniforms, fleet, equipment, routing, carrier readiness, communications, and operating controls.
* Coordinate cross-functional implementation activities, manage dependencies and risks, and maintain clear milestones, decisions, ownership, and status reporting.
* Drive post-launch adoption and ensure new processes, tools, contracts, and standards become embedded in routine operations.

**People & Organizational Leadership**

* Lead, develop, and deploy assigned AHD support resources against the highest-priority operational and strategic needs.
* Establish clear roles, decision rights, service expectations, workload priorities, and performance standards for centralized support functions.
* Build a high-accountability, service-oriented culture that partners effectively with Regional Directors, site leaders, carriers, and cross-functional teams.
* Coach and develop team members through ongoing feedback, development planning, and recommendations regarding staffing, selection, recognition, and performance actions in accordance with company policy.

**Qualifications:**

**Education**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Operations, Supply Chain, Logistics, Industrial Engineering, or a related field preferred.
* Equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience may be considered.

**Experience**

* 10+ years of progressive experience in operations, transportation, logistics, supply chain, home delivery, final mile, or a related field.
* 5+ years of leadership experience with responsibility for teams, operational programs, or multi-site/multi-market operations.
* Demonstrated experience leading operational excellence, process improvement, performance management, and large-scale implementation initiatives.
* Experience managing third-party carriers, 3PL providers, vendors, or outsourced delivery operations.
* Experience developing and managing KPIs, scorecards, operating reviews, and performance improvement plans.
* Demonstrated ability to lead complex, cross-functional projects from planning through implementation and sustained adoption.

**Additional Qualifications, Preferred**

* Experience in final-mile delivery, retail distribution, home delivery, furniture delivery, or similar customer-facing logistics operations.
* Strong knowledge of routing, capacity planning, delivery forecasting, carrier management, and operational controls.
* Experience developing SOPs, governance frameworks, compliance processes, and audit programs.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate operational data into clear business actions.
* Proven ability to influence field and cross-functional leaders in a matrixed environment.
* Strong project and change-management capabilities with experience managing multiple priorities simultaneously.
* Excellent written, verbal, presentation, and executive communication skills.
* Ability to travel as business needs require.

**Benefits We Offer:**

* Health, Dental, Vision, Employee Assistance Program
* Paid Time Off; increases with years of service
* Generous Employee Discount on home furnishings
* Professional Development Opportunities
* Tuition Assistance
* Ashley Wellness Centers (location specific)
* 401(k) and Profit Sharing
* Life Insurance

**Our Core Values:**

* **Honesty & Integrity:** Acts with transparency, discretion, and ethical judgment. Trusted to handle sensitive information and provide accurate, unbiased insights.

* **Dirty Fingernail:** Takes full accountability for outcomes, not just tasks. Inspects details, ensures data accuracy, and follows through to completion.

* **Continuous Improvement:** Actively seeks better ways to improve templates, tools, and processes. Learns from prior initiatives and embeds lessons into standard work.

* **Growth & Results Focus:** Understands how transformation initiatives drive growth, cost reduction, and profitability. Keeps work aligned to enterprise priorities.

* **Culture of Leadership**: Leads through influence, reliability, and example. Builds trust across functions and supports leaders at every level.

* **Customer-Centric & Boundaryless:** Works across silos for the greater good of the organization. Ensures outputs meet the needs of executives, initiative owners, and teams.

* **Operational Excellence:** Demonstrates strong organizational discipline, attention to detail, and the ability to translate ambiguity into clear, executable tools.

 

Interested in learning more about Ashley Furniture’s Community Engagement programs, Environmental Stewardship, or our Core Values, click the links below:

**Corporate Social Responsibility** (https://www.ashleyfurniture.com/about-us/corporate-social-responsibility/report/)

**View Our Corporate Brochure** (https://nam10.safelinks.protection.outlook.com/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.ashleyfurnitureindustriesllc.com%2Fen%2Fcorporate-brochure&data=05%7C02%7CShLee%40Ashleyfurniture.com%7C7380207222ee4e223aea08dd96e531de%7C5a9d9cfdc32e4ac1a9edfe83df4f9e4d%7C0%7C0%7C638832633331666148%7CUnknown%7CTWFpbGZsb3d8eyJFbXB0eU1hcGkiOnRydWUsIlYiOiIwLjAuMDAwMCIsIlAiOiJXaW4zMiIsIkFOIjoiTWFpbCIsIldUIjoyfQ%3D%3D%7C0%7C%7C%7C&sdata=wNmuyaqBcPo%2FSsLdHmzI%2F3XX3FQf%2Fjy3iHyYUhbP8V8%3D&reserved=0)

While Ashley appreciates the interest of all candidates only those meeting specific position requirements may be contacted. This job description does not constitute a written or implied contract of employment. The company reserves the right to revise or change job duties and responsibilities as the need arises.

 

**Notice to Search Firms:** *We are not seeking assistance or accepting unsolicited resumes from search firms. We will not pay any placement, referral or other fees to any search firms unless we have agreed otherwise in a valid, written agreement for the specific position posted and signed by an authorized representative of Ashley Furniture Industries.*

 

***Please note this position is not eligible for current or future employment sponsorship. Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for visa sponsorship now or at any time in the future.***

new_roles.description:
Multi-Unit General Manager

**District Kitchen & Bar + PUBLIC eat+drink** 
Berkshire County, Massachusetts

Compensation

**$130,000–$160,000 total compensation** (base salary + performance bonus)

The Opportunity

We are seeking an experienced, results-driven Multi-Unit General Manager to oversee two established, high-volume independent restaurants in the Berkshires. This is a senior leadership role for someone who thrives on building strong teams, driving profitability, implementing systems, and creating operational excellence.

The ideal candidate is equal parts operator, coach, and business strategist. You'll work directly with ownership to improve performance across both locations while ensuring exceptional guest experiences and a strong workplace culture.

Key Objectives

Success in this role will be measured by:

* Growing top-line revenue
* Increasing restaurant profitability
* Reducing controllable costs
* Implementing scalable systems and procedures
* Developing and retaining high-performing managers
* Improving accountability and operational consistency
* Strengthening guest satisfaction and online reputation

ResponsibilitiesBusiness Performance

* Own P&L performance for both restaurants
* Analyze financial results and identify opportunities for revenue growth and margin improvement
* Develop and execute plans to increase sales, traffic, and guest frequency
* Monitor labor, food, beverage, and operating costs
* Establish measurable KPIs and hold management teams accountable

Leadership & Team Development

* Recruit, hire, train, and develop management staff as needed
* Create a culture of accountability, professionalism, and hospitality
* Conduct regular performance reviews and coaching sessions
* Build leadership depth within both organizations
* Resolve employee issues quickly and professionally

Operations

* Ensure consistent execution of service, food quality, and hospitality standards
* Standardize systems and procedures across both locations where appropriate
* Oversee scheduling, staffing levels, inventory controls, and purchasing
* Improve efficiency and eliminate operational bottlenecks
* Maintain compliance with all health, safety, labor, and licensing requirements

Revenue Growth

* Partner with ownership on marketing and promotional initiatives
* Identify opportunities to increase guest counts, check averages, and repeat business
* Oversee private events, catering opportunities, and community partnerships
* Evaluate menu performance and pricing strategies alongside culinary leadership

Qualifications

* 5+ years of senior restaurant management experience
* Multi-unit management experience strongly preferred
* Demonstrated success improving restaurant profitability
* Strong financial acumen with deep understanding of P&L management
* Experience managing managers and building leadership teams
* Proven ability to create systems, processes, and accountability structures
* Strong communication and organizational skills
* Hospitality-first mindset combined with strong business discipline

Ideal Candidate

You are:

* Highly accountable and results-oriented
* Comfortable making difficult decisions
* Analytical and data-driven
* Skilled at motivating teams and developing leaders
* Focused on continuous improvement
* Equally comfortable in the dining room, the kitchen, and the financial statements

What We Offer

* Competitive compensation package of $130,000–$160,000 annually
* Significant performance-based bonus opportunity
* High level of autonomy and decision-making authority
* Opportunity to make a meaningful impact on two well-established restaurants
* Direct partnership with ownership on strategy and growth initiatives

To Apply

Please submit your resume along with a brief note outlining:

* Your multi-unit management experience
* A specific example of improving profitability at a restaurant operation
* Why this opportunity interests you

Pay: $130,000.00 - $160,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Paid time off

Work Location: In person

new_roles.description:
**We're Hiring: Director of Operations | Poolwerx**

Are you a strategic operational leader passionate about driving franchise success and organic sales growth? Poolwerx is looking for a dynamic Director of Operations to lead our field operations team, coach franchise partners, and champion operational excellence across our network.

**About the Role**

Reporting directly to the Chief Operating Officer, the Director of Operations develops and coordinates the efforts of the Operations team. You will deliver high-value support service spanning business coaching, leadership, salesmanship, and operational execution—all while fostering a positive brand and sales culture among our Franchise Partners.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Drive Growth:** Deliver planned organic sales growth projections for franchise partners and regions while optimizing tracking, measurement, and reward systems.
* **Network Expansion:** Partner with franchise development to facilitate the introduction of new partners, stores, and acquisition opportunities.
* **Leadership & Team Management:** Manage and empower Field Operations, Franchise Business Coaches (FBCs), Onboarding Specialists, Technical Trainers, and Customer Experience Teams.
* **Technical & Field Excellence:** Lead Technical Trainers to ensure technicians master cleaning, maintenance, service, and repair standards; spend time in-field conducting site visits with partners.
* **Cross-Functional Collaboration:** Work closely with Commercial (B2B), Supply Chain, and Marketing teams to unlock local and regional growth opportunities.
* **Operational Alignment & Innovation:** Act as Operations Advisor for Innovation/Evolution programs to drive standard practices across the entire network.

**What We're Looking For**

* **Education:** Undergraduate degree in Business Administration or a related field.
* **Experience:** Extensive field or sales management experience in a franchise, multi-site, or retail environment (pool industry experience highly desired).
* **Financial Acumen:** Strong business acumen with proven ability to analyze and report on P&L and manage departmental budgets.
* **Tech Savvy:** Proficient with Google Workspace, MS Office, CRM systems, and modern business improvement platforms.
* **Communication & Mindset:** Strong, influential communicator with a proactive, resilient, and collaborative "can-do" attitude.

**How to Apply**

If you're ready to take your leadership career to the next level with a growing industry leader, submit your application today or reach out directly to learn more!

Pay: $140,000.00 - $150,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Flexible schedule
* Flexible spending account
* Health insurance
* Health savings account
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Retirement plan
* Vision insurance

identity_held_roles.title: Regional Director of Quality Engineering
identity_held_roles.description:
**Description**

Sanmina Corporation (Nasdaq: SANM) is a global powerhouse in integrated manufacturing solutions serving the fastest growing segments of the global Electronics Manufacturing Services (EMS) market. We are a global engine providing the end-to-end manufacturing backbone for the world's most essential and innovative brands. Whether it's autonomous vehicles, life-saving medical tech, next-gen aerospace, or AI/cloud infrastructure - our integrated solutions don’t just meet standards—they redefine them.Sanmina Corporation (Nasdaq: SANM) is a leading integrated manufacturing solutions provider serving the fastest-growing segments of the global Electronics Manufacturing Services (EMS) market. Job Purpose:As Quality Director the role will be responsible for developing a world class quality culture and drive region wide continuous improvement projects that result in unparalleled quality performance. You will have the opportunity to reinforce foundational quality principles, as we develop innovative manufacturing, test, inspection and automation processes to build high quality semiconductor, defense and data infrastructure products. This position will be responsible for managing, coordinating and administering all functions of the region’s Quality Management System.What You'll DoLead and mentor QA organizations.Be an outspoken advocate for Quality First throughout the regionExpediently and effectively communicate with customers on quality escapes, visits, escalations, etc.Help maintain and improve the site QMS (including NCR and CAPA system, internal audit, training, etc.)Responsible for ensuring effective quality planning (including PFMEAs, process flows and control plans) for NPI and production parts.Help maintain the site QMS compliance with ISO 9001:2015 and TL9000, ISO 13485, FDA registration and any other regulatory compliance in line with the factory center of excellence Act as advisory to developing additional sources of data and tracking and reporting key Quality-related performance indicators (KPIs), including first pass yield, scrap rates and statistical process control.Oversight of managing and improving site supplier qualityBe an advocate for lean and six sigma manufacturing principles and drive continuous improvementDrive cross functional projects with manufacturing, supply chain, and engineering to verify and validate existing manufacturing processes and capabilitiesCoordinate development of Quality Plan and participate in Design for Manufacturability (DFM) reviews for new customer on-boardingAddress process yields by driving cross-functional teams to develop and implement corrective actions utilizing a methodical approach (DMAIC) to root cause and continuous improvement. What You'll BringBachelor’s Degree required, Mechanical, Aerospace, Industrial or Mfg Engineering preferred10+ years of Quality Engineering or Management experience in a regulated manufacturing environment. Printed circuit board experience is a plus but not required5+ years of direct people managementKnowledge of IPC-6012 and IPC-A-600 desiredDemonstrated experience working directly with customers to resolve concerns, conduct audits and host visitsUnderstanding of ISO 9001:2015, AS9100, TL-9000, ISO-14385, ISO-14001, MIL-PRF-31032 or similar standards with demonstrated success in passing certification auditsExpert level knowledge of root cause analysis techniques and corrective actionHands on experience working with suppliers to improve qualityKnowledge of lean principles (Green or Black belt certification a plus)Knowledge and experience in the application of statistical process controlDemonstrated experience leading diverse teams in a dynamic environment requiredExcellent written and verbal communication and presentation skills requiredOpen-minded self-starter with the ability to adapt, improvise and problem solve, as well manage multiple tasks and projects and concisely explain complex issues supported with data.Excellent analytical abilities and comprehensive understanding of quality toolbox (SPC, 8D, FMEA, Control Plans, etc.) Salary Range (annual): $140,000 - $165,000 Why Join Us?At Sanmina, base pay is one part of our total compensation package and is determined within a range. This provides the opportunity to progress as you grow and develop within a role. The base pay range for this role is between $xx and $xx, and your base pay will depend on your skills, qualifications, experience, and location.Sanmina employees also receive benefits including: Comprehensive medical and dental coverage, retirement benefits, and for formal education related to advancing your career at Sanmina, reimbursement for certain educational expenses — including tuition. Additionally, this role might be eligible for discretionary bonuses or commission payments as well as relocation.Sanmina is an Equal Opportunity Employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment. Sanmina provides equal employment opportunities to employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws.Please be aware that this position may require access to technology, software, or technical data that is subject to U.S. export control laws. identity_held_roles.title: Director of Corporate Quality & Compliance
identity_held_roles.description:
**ABOUT VSE**

We’ve been in business since 1981, founded on the principle of providing the best services to our customers through hard work and a commitment to excellence. VSE provides superior turn-key PCB solutions that exceed industry exacting standards. We provide assembly and engineering services for electro-mechanical products.

VSE exists to empower life-changing and life-saving technologies worldwide. We are successful because of our commitment to exceptional customer service, being nimble, and delivering the highest quality.

Our team members are humble, curious, and electric! We are team players, practicing gratitude and treating others with respect. We are passionate learners, hungry for understanding and eager to explore. We are energized with positivity, wired, and driven to succeed!

Join our team to unlock our dynamic benefits: competitive pay, generous 401k match, flexible schedules, paid time off, holiday pay, health and wellness, along with opportunities for growth and development.

**This role is open to candidates in Reno, Nevada and San Jose, California.**

**Position Summary**

The Director of Corporate Quality & Compliance is responsible for establishing, leading, and continuously improving the company's Quality Management Systems (QMS), regulatory compliance, and overall quality performance across multiple manufacturing locations.

This role provides strategic leadership for corporate and site-level Quality functions, ensuring compliance with industry standards, customer requirements, and applicable regulatory requirements while driving a culture of quality, accountability, and continuous improvement.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead and maintain the company's Quality Management Systems across all manufacturing locations, including ISO 9001, ISO 13485, and AS9100.
* Establish and execute the corporate quality strategy, including certification planning, QMS development, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Ensure compliance with applicable FDA regulations and requirements for medical device products and manufacturing processes.
* Oversee manufacturing process validation, including IQ/OQ/PQ, process controls, change management, calibration, and product traceability.
* Lead customer, supplier, internal, and certification audits, ensuring effective corrective actions and ongoing compliance.
* Develop and maintain strong customer quality relationships, leading quality reviews, escalations, and corrective action initiatives.
* Oversee Supplier Quality Management, including supplier qualification, performance monitoring, audits, and corrective actions.
* Drive company-wide quality performance through KPIs, CAPA, 8D, root cause analysis, and risk management.
* Lead Lean Manufacturing and continuous improvement initiatives, including Lean Six Sigma, 5S, waste reduction, and process optimization.
* Lead and develop Site Quality Managers, Supplier Quality Engineers, and Customer Quality Engineers across multiple locations.
* Partner with Operations, Engineering, Purchasing, and other departments to identify systemic issues and improve product and process quality.
* Promote a proactive quality culture focused on prevention, risk management, customer satisfaction, and accountability.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Manufacturing, Quality Management, or a related field.
* 10+ years of Quality experience in electronics manufacturing, PCB assembly, or contract manufacturing, including 5+ years leading Quality teams.
* Working knowledge of ISO 9001, ISO 13485, AS9100, and applicable FDA regulations, with experience leading AS9100 implementation and ongoing compliance.
* Experience with medical device manufacturing and process validation.
* Experience managing customer quality, supplier quality, audits, and corrective action (8D, CAPA, root cause analysis).
* Knowledge of IPC-A-610, IPC/WHMA-A-620, and J-STD-001.
* Experience implementing Lean, Six Sigma, and 5S.

* ASQ CMQ/OE, CQE, or ISO Lead Auditor certification is preferred.
* Experience supporting aerospace, defense, and medical device customers.
* Experience leading multi-site Quality organizations.
* Strong leadership, communication, and customer relationship skills.

**VSE is an Equal Opportunity Employer.** We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace and consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

identity_held_roles.title: Senior Manager of Customer Quality
identity_held_roles.description:
Since 2018, Elevate Aircraft Seating has been enhancing the passenger experience through innovative aircraft seat design and manufacturing. With locations in California, Washington, and Germany we are guided by creativity, collaboration, and a shared commitment to quality.

We are looking for a skilled Senior Customer Quality Manager to join our team in Charleston, South Carolina. This is an on-site position based in Charleston, South Carolina. We value teamwork, inclusivity, and continuous professional development, and we offer competitive benefits along with opportunities for growth.

**Export Control Requirements:**

**This position must meet U.S. export control compliance requirements. To meet U.S. export control compliance requirements, a “U.S. Person” as defined by 22 C.F.R. §120.62 is required. “U.S. Person” includes U.S. Citizen, U.S. National, lawful permanent resident, refugee, or asylee.**

**JOB SUMMARY**

The Senior Manager of Customer Quality serves as the primary quality liaison between Elevate Aircraft Seating's manufacturing locations, Onsite Support Services (OSS), Boeing, and airline customers, ensuring effective communication, timely resolution of quality issues, and alignment with customer and regulatory requirements. This highly visible, customer-facing position is responsible for leading defect investigations, root cause analysis, and corrective action coordination while driving quality improvements back into manufacturing operations to prevent recurring issues and strengthen product conformity. The Senior Manager of Customer Quality partners cross-functionally with Engineering, Manufacturing, Quality, and customer stakeholders to drive accountability, proactively address quality concerns, and strengthen customer relationships. This position also provides executive leadership with data-driven reporting on quality performance, emerging risks, corrective actions, and continuous improvement initiatives to support informed decision-making and operational excellence.

**SUMMARY OF JOB DUTIES** - **Essential Functions****(Other duties and projects may be assigned or requested.)**

*Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential*

**Customer Quality Leadership & Stakeholder Management**

* Serve as the primary quality liaison between Elevate manufacturing locations, Onsite Support Services (OSS), Boeing, and airline customers, ensuring alignment on quality concerns, operational priorities, and resolution activities.
* Lead customer-facing quality discussions, providing technically accurate information, objective evidence, and clear communication regarding product conformity, nonconformances, and corrective actions.
* Establish and maintain structured communication cadences with internal and external stakeholders to ensure timely escalation, consistent messaging, and accountability for quality-related issues.
* Build and maintain strong customer relationships through proactive engagement, effective problem-solving, and timely resolution of quality concerns.

**Defect Management & Technical Quality Assurance**

* Lead the investigation, documentation, and resolution of product defects and nonconformances, identifying root causes, points of origin, and appropriate corrective actions across manufacturing, receiving inspection, and final assembly operations.
* Evaluate reported nonconformances against applicable Letters of Conformance (LOCs), approved craftsmanship documentation, engineering specifications, and customer requirements to ensure accurate defect classification and resolution.
* Partner with Boeing and internal Quality and Engineering teams on corrective action investigations, providing technical analysis, objective evidence, and recommendations to support effective resolution.
* Develop and maintain a thorough understanding of aircraft interior products, functionality, design requirements, and installation processes to effectively evaluate quality concerns and communicate technical findings.
* Coordinate appropriate inspection and acceptance testing support during aircraft installation activities, including verification of electrical connections, mechanical functionality, and applicable acceptance test procedures (ATP).

**Quality Management Systems & Regulatory Compliance**

* Ensure customer-facing quality activities align with applicable FAA/EASA regulations, AS9100 standards, customer specifications, and internal Quality Management System (QMS) requirements.
* Maintain accurate, traceable quality documentation and defect records through established systems, including SharePoint, ensuring appropriate stakeholders have access to current information and supporting evidence.
* Coordinate the communication and implementation of applicable service bulletins, engineering changes, and product effectivity requirements across manufacturing locations, OSS, Boeing, and customers.
* Support customer quality reviews, audits, and regulatory compliance activities by providing technical documentation, investigation findings, and corrective action evidence.

**Corrective Action & Continuous Improvement**

* Drive cross-functional corrective and preventive action initiatives to address customer quality concerns, eliminate recurring defects, and strengthen manufacturing process effectiveness.
* Translate customer quality feedback, defect trends, and investigation findings into actionable improvement opportunities for manufacturing, Engineering, and Quality teams.
* Apply root cause analysis, statistical methods, and structured problem-solving techniques to validate defect origins, assess corrective action effectiveness, and support sustainable improvements.
* Identify emerging quality risks and recurring issues, proactively escalating concerns and coordinating mitigation activities to minimize customer impact and prevent recurrence.

**Executive Reporting & Cross-Functional Quality Performance**

* Develop and present quality performance reports, defect trends, corrective action status, and emerging risks to executive leadership, providing data-driven insights and recommendations to support operational decision-making.
* Establish and monitor key quality performance indicators (KPIs) related to customer defects, resolution timelines, recurring issues, and corrective action effectiveness.
* Partner with Manufacturing, Engineering, Quality, Program Management, and OSS teams to drive accountability, coordinate issue resolution, and ensure timely implementation of quality improvements across affected operations.
* Monitor customer quality deliverables, open issues, and corrective action commitments to ensure alignment with program milestones, customer expectations, and organizational quality objectives.

**Other**

* Maintain a safe, secure and legal work environment, adhering to all Company policies and procedures.
* Protect the confidentiality of the Company’s information and products.
* Contribute to team efforts by performing other job-related duties and projects as assigned or requested.

**GENERAL QUALIFICATIONS – Education, Knowledge, and Experience**

**Education:**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering or related technical field is required.

**Experience:**

* Minimum of 8 years of progressive experience in quality assurance, quality engineering, or quality management within aerospace manufacturing or a related highly regulated industry.
* Demonstrated ability to develop and present quality performance metrics, defect trends, corrective action status, and risk assessments to senior leadership and executive stakeholders.
* Proven track record of leading cross-functional quality improvement initiatives, influencing stakeholders without direct authority, and translating customer quality concerns into sustainable manufacturing improvements.
* Extensive background in defect investigations, root cause analysis, nonconformance management, and corrective and preventive actions (CAPA) across manufacturing and customer operations.
* Demonstrated ability to serve as a primary quality interface with customers, including managing complex quality concerns, presenting technical findings, and driving issue resolution.
* Minimum of 5 years working with aerospace quality standards, FAA/EASA regulatory requirements, product conformity, and applicable customer quality requirements.

**Skills:**

* In-depth knowledge of AS9100 standards, FAA/EASA regulations, aerospace quality requirements, product conformity, and applicable airworthiness standards.
* Strong technical understanding of aircraft interior products, manufacturing processes, installation requirements, and quality documentation, including Letters of Conformance (LOCs) and approved craftsmanship standards.
* Advanced proficiency in nonconformance management, root cause analysis, corrective and preventive actions (CAPA), and evidence-based defect investigation and resolution.
* Exceptional communication, negotiation, and relationship management skills, with the ability to present complex technical findings, resolve customer concerns, and influence internal and external stakeholders.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to interpret quality data, identify trends, evaluate risks, and present actionable recommendations to executive leadership.
* Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional initiatives, establish structured communication processes, drive accountability, and implement sustainable quality improvements without direct supervisory authority.

**Preferred Skills/Experience:**

* Familiarity with Boeing quality requirements, customer-specific specifications, craftsmanship standards, and aircraft final assembly or onsite support operations.
* Formal training or practical experience conducting customer, regulatory, or third-party quality audits within the aerospace industry.
* Working knowledge of advanced quality methodologies, including APQP, FMEA, Statistical Process Control (SPC), and AS9145 requirements.
* Proficiency in AS9102 First Article Inspection (FAI) requirements, Material Review Board (MRB) processes, and aerospace product conformity documentation.
* Knowledge of aircraft interior systems, including seating, electrical and mechanical functionality, installation processes, and acceptance testing procedures (ATP).

* Extended or irregular hours may be required.
* Must be authorized to work in the United States.
* Ability to travel up to 25% of the time.

* Tasks may vary slightly based on products produced at a division.

**LEADERSHIP RESPONSIBILITY**

* Oversee the work of others.
* Assist with coordination of adherence to organizational goals, operating policies, and budgetary guidelines.

**PROBLEM SOLVING**

* Develop and provide solutions to complex problems based on established precedents and are consistent with organization objectives.

**LANGUAGE SKILLS**

* Ability to communicate effectively in English, both verbally and in writing.

existing_roles.description:
Are you ready to build America’s energy future? Form Energy is an American manufacturing and energy technology company. We’re revolutionizing energy storage with cost-effective, multi-day technology designed to keep the electric grid secure and reliable, even during extended periods of stress. By strengthening the electric system and reimagining what’s possible, we’re giving clean energy a whole new form!

In recent years, Form Energy has earned a number of accolades, including being named by *TIME* as a “Best Invention”, *MIT Technology Review* as a “Top Climate Tech Company To Watch”, and *Fast Company* as “One of the Next Big Things In Tech”. We are making rapid progress on our mission of delivering energy storage for a better world, and our team is growing just as rapidly to meet demand. We have signed contracts with leading electric utilities across the United States and production of our iron-air batteries is underway at our first high-volume manufacturing facility in West Virginia.

Working for Form Energy is more than just a job, it’s a chance to be part of something extraordinary. And now - right as we significantly scale up battery manufacturing - might be the most exciting moment in the company’s history to join. We are assembling a team of highly talented and driven individuals across the country. Driven by our core values of humanity, excellence, and creativity, our team is determined to deliver on our mission and transform the energy landscape for the better.

* Lead, develop, and mentor Quality leaders and team members, building organizational capability and ensuring appropriate talent development and succession planning.

* Demonstrated ability to influence decisions and drive results across functions without relying solely on direct authority.

* Experience managing multiple concurrent technical, quality, and operational priorities.

existing_roles.title: Director of Quality
existing_roles.description:
Are you a quality leader who enjoys building systems, developing teams, and creating a culture of continuous improvement? Advantic Building Group is seeking a Director of Quality to lead enterprise-wide quality strategy, establish a scalable Quality Management System (QMS), drive ISO 9001 certification efforts, and partner with leaders across engineering, manufacturing, supply chain, and field operations to deliver exceptional customer outcomes. This is a unique opportunity to build and shape the future of quality within a growing organization.

At Advantic Building Group, we design, fabricate, and install innovative Fiber Reinforced Polymer (FRP) structural systems that help our customers build smarter, safer, and more efficiently.

But what truly sets Advantic apart isn’t just what we build — it’s **how** we work and **who** we work with.

We're a team that values ownership, camaraderie, and curiosity. We roll up our sleeves, tackle challenges together, and support one another along the way. As we continue to grow, we're looking for a quality leader who shares those values and can help strengthen the culture we've built while establishing the systems, processes, and accountability necessary to deliver exceptional quality outcomes for our customers.

**Why Join Advantic?**

* Lead the development of a scalable enterprise-wide Quality Management System (QMS)
* Drive Advantic's ISO 9001 certification journey
* Influence quality across engineering, manufacturing, supply chain, and field operations
* Build and develop a growing quality organization
* Partner directly with senior leadership to shape strategic initiatives
* Make a visible impact on customer success, operational excellence, and company growth

  

**Role Summary**

The Director of Quality provides strategic leadership for quality across engineering, supply chain, manufacturing, assembly, and field operations. This role is responsible for developing and executing Advantic Building Group's quality strategy, building a scalable Quality Management System (QMS), leading ISO 9001 certification efforts, and driving continuous improvement throughout the organization.

This leader partners closely with operations, engineering, supply chain, and project teams to reduce defects, improve process performance, strengthen customer confidence, and support the company's growth objectives.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Quality Leadership and Strategic Planning**

* Develop and execute a quality roadmap aligned with business growth, customer commitments, operational risks, and manufacturing and construction requirements; set annual objectives, priorities, and resource needs, including staffing, inspection equipment, and quality technology.
* Report quality performance, emerging risks, and cost of poor quality (scrap, rework, field repairs, returns, warranty) to senior leadership with clear owners, deadlines, and escalation expectations, and partner with Operations and Delivery to reduce it.

**Quality Management Systems (QMS) & ISO 9001 Leadership**

* Develop, implement, and continuously improve Advantic's Quality Management System (QMS), while leading ISO 9001 certification readiness, certification audits, surveillance audits, and recertification activities.
* Build a scalable, practical Quality Management System that enables operational consistency, supports growth, improves customer satisfaction, and achieves ISO 9001 certification.
* Govern document, configuration, and revision control across engineering drawings, submittals, production information, and field documentation, and ensure quality records are reliable and accessible across ERP, MES, and document systems with defined data ownership.

**Manufacturing Quality, Process Control & Continuous Improvement**

* Establish inspection and test plans, acceptance criteria, and release controls for incoming materials, in-process fabrication, final assembly, packaging, and pre-shipment verification, ensuring products conform to approved drawings, engineering requirements, customer specifications, and applicable contractual and industry requirements.
* Partner with Operations on specification review, design reviews, process risk assessments, first-build validation, and readiness for new or changed products and processes; coordinate qualified technical resources when specialized expertise is needed.
* Define traceability, inspection records, measuring equipment controls, calibration, and measurement method validation appropriate to risk and application.
* Establish controls for FRP materials and structural assemblies, including storage, handling, fabrication, and special processes.

**Corrective Actions, Root Cause Analysis & Quality Improvement**

* Lead the enterprise nonconformance and corrective action process, including containment, material disposition, root cause analysis, escalation management, and verification of corrective action effectiveness across internal, supplier, customer, and field-related issues.
* Exercise authority under approved procedures to quarantine material, hold shipments, or stop affected work when conformity is in question; coordinate technical dispositions and obtain required customer approval for concessions or deviations, while maintaining independence of quality decisions.

**Supplier, Subcontractor, & Field Quality Management**

* Partner with Supply Chain to establish supplier qualification, approval, audit, and performance monitoring, including quality requirements for outsourced services and subcontracted work, and maintain approval status in the approved supplier system.
* Ensure certifications, traceability, inspection evidence, and customer requirements are flowed down to suppliers and verified.
* Lead supplier corrective actions and improvement plans, and support cost recovery within established commercial authority.
* Develop the field quality program for construction management and data center white space work, including project quality plan templates, inspection and test plan requirements, hold and witness points, and documentation standards that on-site QC managers must follow.
* Set expectations for, train, and hold on-site QC managers accountable to the program through project kickoffs, periodic field audits, and review of inspection records, field non-conformances, and punch list and turnover documentation.
* Serve as the escalation point for field quality issues and the senior quality contact for customers and third-party inspectors during audits and handover.

  

**Performance Measures**

* Establish baselines, targets, and reporting definitions with leadership. Measures include first-pass yield, scrap and rework, cost of poor quality, nonconformance recurrence and closure time, corrective action effectiveness, supplier performance, customer complaints, field deficiencies, audit completion, calibration compliance, and progress against the quality roadmap.

  

**People Leadership and Shared Accountability**

* Lead hiring, onboarding, coaching, performance management, and development of quality personnel, with training matrices, competency expectations, and succession plans.
* Partner with operational leaders to build quality awareness across the organization, and hold process owners accountable through agreed governance and escalation, reinforcing that each department owns the quality of its work.
* Model Ownership, Camaraderie, and Curiosity through clear expectations, respectful challenge, and consistent follow-through.

  

**What We're Looking For**

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, manufacturing, quality, or a related discipline, or equivalent directly relevant experience.
* Ten or more years of progressive quality experience, including five or more years leading a quality team or function in manufacturing or a comparable technical environment.
* Demonstrated success building, implementing, or significantly improving Quality Management Systems (QMS).
* Experience leading ISO 9001 implementation, certification readiness, and managing internal, customer, and third-party audits.
* Proven results developing people, leading change across departments, and reducing defects, repeat failures, or quality-related costs.
* Ability to interpret engineering drawings, specifications, and inspection requirements; practical knowledge of measurement systems, traceability, process controls, and structured problem-solving.
* Experience using ERP, MES, electronic quality systems, or comparable tools to establish dependable workflows and actionable reporting.
* Ability to communicate clearly with customers, frontline employees, and senior leaders; make sound decisions under pressure; and resolve competing quality, schedule, and business priorities.

  

*Preferred Qualifications*

* Experience with FRP or composite products, structural fabrication, engineered assemblies, construction quality, or mission-critical and data center projects.
* Experience connecting manufacturing quality with field installation, subcontractor oversight, customer acceptance, and project turnover.
* ASQ CMQ/OE, CQE, or CQA certification; ISO 9001 lead auditor qualification; or Lean Six Sigma training with demonstrated application.

  

**Physical demands**

While performing the duties of this position, the employee is regularly required to communicate effectively through speaking and listening. The role typically involves prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer. The employee may occasionally be required to stand, walk, reach with hands and arms, and lift or move objects up to 15 pounds.

*Advantic Building Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, or gender identity), national origin, age, disability status, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.*

existing_roles.description:
**Senior Director, Manufacturing Operations**

*Own the supply chain and CMC project engine behind Nurix's clinical programs and commercial readiness. In this multifaceted role, you will select and manage CMOs, keep clinical supply flowing to trial sites around the world, and drive cross-functional CMC plans from early development toward commercialization, in a small, entrepreneurial environment with broad responsibilities.*

  

**Position Description**

The position is a multifaceted role supporting several areas within the Technical Operations group, including supply chain management, CMC project management, and clinical labeling and distribution. The ideal candidate will be highly motivated and self-directed, with experience and interest in working in a small, entrepreneurial environment with broad responsibilities and opportunities.

  

**The Opportunity**

* Lead the effort to identify, select, and manage Contract Manufacturing Organizations (CMOs) for the development and cGMP manufacture of raw materials, RSMs, and DS in support of ongoing clinical programs and commercial products (with finance and commercial teams)
* Manage global supply chains and logistics in support of demand for clinical studies and commercial products
* Working in conjunction with technical teams, provide vendor management support in all logistics and operations to ensure on-time delivery of materials
* Coordinate the design and execution of cross-functional CMC project plans and budgeting for early clinical development through commercial readiness
* Maintain frequent communication with cross-functional CMC project team members and key internal stakeholders so that all parties are aware of current project status, issues, contingencies, milestones, and budgets
* Proactively identify the CMC critical path, risks, and impediments to successful development, and drive the identification and development of solutions to mitigate these risks
* Serve as primary clinical supply chain contact, working collaboratively with internal and external partners
* Manage clinical supply planning and forecasting for study protocols and develop packaging/labeling and global distribution strategies
* Monitor IXRS portal processes, including high and low enrolling site settings, drug acknowledgement, depot and site supply levels, and IMP status of released lots or expired drug
* Coordinate the preparation and/or review of CMC sections of INDs, CTAs, NDAs, MAAs, and other regulatory submissions to ensure timely distribution of clinical trial materials
* Coordinate the process validation programs to support commercialization
* Initiate and manage high-value intercontinental, cross-border, and domestic shipments
* Coordinate the preparation, review, editing, and approval of cGMP batch records and CMC regulatory and Quality documents
* Coordinate the preparation of technical reports, publications, and oral presentations

  

**What You'll Bring**

* BS with 15+ years' experience; degree in Pharmaceutical Chemistry, Organic Chemistry, Pharmaceutics, Pharmaceutical Science, or a related scientific discipline
* At least 10 years of relevant experience in a pharmaceutical or biotechnology CMC/cGMP environment
* Excellent project management skills and the ability to work cross-functionally to develop and execute project plans
* Experience managing US and international CRO/CMOs for the manufacture of raw materials, RSMs, and cGMP DS and DP for programs in development
* Experience with clinical supply chain, including forecasting supply needs
* Experience with cGMP manufacturing and IND, CTA, and NDA filings; thorough knowledge of relevant FDA and EMEA regulations
* Experience in supply chain management, and experience establishing pharmaceutical supply chain systems and networks
* Able to identify and resolve critical issues
* Sufficient technical background and experience to work closely with other technical functional areas
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, and exceptional interpersonal and management skills to collaborate with others on assigned projects (including both internal teams and external collaborators)
* Bonus: Advanced degree in Pharmaceutical Chemistry, Organic Chemistry, Pharmaceutics, Pharmaceutical Science, or a related scientific discipline
* Bonus: Experience managing US and international CMOs for commercial programs

  

**Salary Range:** $270,300 - $295,700

*The posted range applies to roles based in the San Francisco Bay Area and reflects local market conditions. Where an offer lands within that range depends on the candidate's relevant experience, technical expertise, and how their background aligns with the role's requirements.*

  

**Location:** Onsite – Brisbane, CA

  

**Fit with Nurix Culture and Values**

* Strong team orientation; highly collaborative
* Solutions and results-oriented focus
* Hands-on approach; resourceful and open to diverse points of view

  

**About Nurix Therapeutics**

*Nurix Therapeutics is a clinical stage biopharmaceutical company focused on the discovery, development, and commercialization of targeted protein degradation medicines, the next frontier in innovative drug design aimed at improving treatment options for patients with cancer and inflammatory diseases. Powered by a fully AI-integrated discovery engine capable of tackling any protein class, and coupled with unparalleled ligase expertise, Nurix's dedicated team has built a formidable advantage in translating the science of targeted protein degradation into clinical advancements. Nurix aims to establish degrader-based treatments at the forefront of patient care, writing medicine's next chapter with a new script to outmatch disease.*

existing_roles.description:
**Why Build Your Career with Prysmian?**

**Your work at Prysmian helps power and connect the world.**

Prysmian, the world leader in solutions for energy and digital connections, strengthen its global team with the 2025 addition of Channell, now part of Prysmian. Founded by the Channell family in 1922, Channell brings a long‑standing legacy of innovation in outside plant infrastructure, serving Telecommunications, Municipalities, Internet Service Providers, Wireless, Water, Power, and CATV markets. Together, Prysmian and Channell team members are combining expertise, craftsmanship, and shared values to deliver a broader portfolio, from advanced cable systems and fiber connectivity solutions to enclosures and below‑grade vaults which support resilient infrastructure, the energy transition, and the growth of digital networks around the world.

When you join Prysmian, you become part of a global team whose work touches millions of lives every day. You’ll help support the energy and digital infrastructure that keeps communities, businesses, and industries moving forward.

For more than 140 years, Prysmian has helped shape the infrastructure that powers progress. From helping illuminate the Statue of Liberty in 1886 and delivering power from Hoover Dam to Los Angeles in 1935, to supporting New York City's rebuilding efforts after September 11, our cables and connectivity solutions have played a role in some of history's most significant milestones.

**What You’ll Bring:**

**Experience and Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in engineering, operations management, business administration, or related field required; MBA or advanced degree preferred.
* 10+ years of progressive manufacturing operations leadership experience, including 5+ years leading multiple sites or a multi-plant network.
* Proven track record managing P&L, capital budgets, and operational KPIs across geographically dispersed facilities.
* Deep knowledge of Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, or comparable continuous improvement methodologies; certification (Lean/Six Sigma Green or Black Belt) preferred.
* Strong experience with ERP/MES systems and data-driven decision-making.
* Demonstrated ability to lead through others, build high-performing teams, and manage change across a diverse, multi-site organization.
* Working knowledge of OSHA, environmental regulations, and quality systems (ISO 9001 or equivalent).
* Experience in electronics, cable/connector, or precision component manufacturing a plus.
* Familiarity with thermoplastic molding - low and high pressure injection molding, rotational molding, and blow molding
* Willingness and ability to travel regularly (up to 40–50%) between facilities, including international travel as applicable.
* Executive-level communication and presentation skills, with the ability to influence senior leadership and the board.
* Strong financial acumen, including budgeting, forecasting, and cost analysis.
* Excellent problem-solving and decision-making skills in a fast-paced, multi-site manufacturing environment.

**What You'll Do:**

The Director of Operations provides strategic and operational leadership across the company's multi-site manufacturing network. This role is accountable for driving safety, quality, productivity, cost, and delivery performance at every facility while building a consistent operating system, talent pipeline, and culture of continuous improvement across locations.

The Director partners closely with Plant Managers, Supply Chain, Engineering, Quality, and HR to ensure each site operates at world-class levels and that capacity, capital, and talent decisions support the company's growth and customer commitments.

**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:**

* Develop and execute the multi-site manufacturing operations strategy in alignment with overall business goals, growth plans, and customer demand.
* Establish and standardize a common operating system (KPIs, daily management, tiered accountability meetings) across all plants to ensure consistent execution and visibility.
* Set annual operating and capital budgets for all locations; own P&L accountability for manufacturing operations.
* Drive productivity, throughput, and cost-reduction initiatives while maintaining or improving quality and service levels.
* Lead capacity planning, footprint strategy, and capital investment decisions across the network, including new equipment, line expansions, or facility consolidations.
* Directly manage and develop Plant Managers/Site Leaders at each location, setting clear performance expectations and holding sites accountable to targets.
* Build bench strength and succession plans for critical operations roles across all sites; partner with HR on talent acquisition, development, and retention strategies.
* Foster a culture of engagement, accountability, and continuous improvement; conduct regular site visits and gemba walks.
* Standardize best practices across facilities and lead cross-site knowledge sharing to eliminate performance variability between plants.
* Champion an EHS-first culture; ensure all locations meet or exceed OSHA and applicable regulatory requirements, with measurable reduction in incident rates.
* Ensure consistent adherence to quality management systems (e.g., ISO 9001) and customer quality requirements across all sites.
* Oversee compliance with environmental, labor, and applicable trade/export regulations at each facility.
* Lead deployment of Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, and/or Continuous Improvement methodologies across all locations.
* Drive standardization of processes, work instructions, and systems (ERP/MES) to improve consistency, data integrity, and decision-making across sites.
* Identify and lead major process improvement, automation, and cost-savings projects with measurable ROI.
* Partner with Supply Chain/Planning to align production schedules with demand, inventory targets, and on-time delivery goals.
* Collaborate with Engineering on new product introductions, process qualifications, and manufacturability improvements.
* Work with Finance on cost accounting, standard costs, and margin improvement initiatives.
* Partner with HR on workforce planning, labor relations, compensation strategy, and organizational design across sites.
* Serve as a key member of the senior leadership team, reporting operational performance and strategic recommendations to executive leadership and/or the board as needed.

**You’ll have the opportunity to make an impact, build strong partnerships, and grow your career in a business that values ownership, collaboration, and continuous improvement.**

**Total Rewards Designed for You:**

We believe great people deserve great rewards. That’s why Prysmian offers a total rewards package designed to support your financial, physical, and personal well-being now and as your career grows.

* **Competitive salary** that recognizes your skills, experience, and contributions
* **Performance-based incentives** that reward your results and impact *(where applicable)*
* **Comprehensive health coverage** with medical, dental, and vision plan options to fit your needs
* **401(k) retirement savings plan** with a competitive company match to help you invest in your future
* **Paid maternity and bonding leave, plus adoption assistance** to support you and your growing family
* **Generous paid time off and company holidays** so you can rest, recharge, and spend time on what matters most
* **Life and disability insurance** for added peace of mind
* **Wellness programs and supplemental insurance options** to support your overall health and well-being

**At Prysmian, you’ll be supported at work, at home, and throughout every stage of your career.**

Kentucky Trailer

As a part of the global industrial organization Marmon Holdings—which is backed by Berkshire Hathaway—you’ll be doing things that matter, leading at every level, and winning a better way. We’re committed to making a positive impact on the world, providing you with diverse learning and working opportunities, and fostering a culture where everyone’s empowered to be their best.

Job Title: Director of Operations
  
Division: Kentucky Trailer  
Location: Louisville, KY- 3 site locations  
Reports to: President, Kentucky Trailer  
FLSA: Exempt  
  
This position has multiple direct reports across 3 sites. Current direct reports include Operations Manager, 7 Team Leaders, and a Manufacturing Engineer/Facilities Manager. This position requires local travel between the 3 sites in Louisville.  
  
Kentucky Trailer has been building in Louisville since 1879, when it was founded as the Kentucky Wagon Manufacturing Company. Today it designs and builds custom trailers and truck bodies for moving and storage, snack food distribution, package delivery, and specialty markets such as mobile medical, government, and motorsports. Most of what we build is engineered to order rather than off the shelf, which makes our operations both challenging and rewarding to lead.  
  
The Director of Operations leads all day-to-day manufacturing operations and is accountable for Safety, Quality, Delivery, Cost, People, and Productivity results. The role owns the manufacturing operating budget, develops frontline leaders, and builds a culture of accountability and continuous improvement. Works closely with Materials, Supply Chain, Engineering, Finance, Human Resources, and Commercial Sales to make sure production plans are executable and customer commitments are met. The workforce is non-union.

**Position Key Accountabilities:**

### **Safety**

* Create and sustain a Safety First and Always culture, with every employee understanding their personal responsibility for a safe workplace.
* Enforce safety policies, procedures and safe work practices at every level of the organization.
* Make sure hazards, near misses and incidents are addressed promptly, with root causes corrected.
* Ensure compliance with OSHA and environmental requirements and lead continuous improvement toward an incident-free workplace.

### **Manufacturing performance and planning**

* Lead daily manufacturing activities to meet production schedules and customer delivery commitments.
* Set clear daily, weekly and monthly expectations for each production area, and align labor and resources to requirements.
* Identify production constraints and implement corrective actions to improve throughput.
* Partner with Supply Chain and Materials so schedules are executable and escalate shortages before they affect production.
* Support point-of-use inventory, Kanban, vendor-managed inventory and other Lean material strategies where appropriate.

### **Quality**

* Build a culture where quality is owned at the point of manufacture and the next operation is treated as the customer.
* Ensure compliance with manufacturing standards, specifications, work instructions and quality procedures.
* Partner with Engineering to drive root-cause corrective action and reduce defects, rework, warranty exposure and cost of poor quality.

### **Lean and operational excellence**

* Champion Lean Manufacturing using 5S, Standard Work, Visual Management, Kaizen and structured problem solving.
* Establish a disciplined management cadence of daily production meetings, visual boards, KPI reviews and structured follow-up.
* Ensure standard work is documented, followed and continuously improved.
* Drive measurable improvement in labor productivity, cycle time, throughput, material flow, space utilization and manufacturing cost.
* Lead automation and capital initiatives that improve safety, quality, productivity and cost.

### **Financial performance and cost**

* Own the manufacturing operating budget and take part in the annual budget and monthly forecasts.
* Manage to labor, overhead and operating cost targets, including direct labor productivity, overtime and indirect labor.
* Ensure accuracy in both labor reporting and BOM usages
* WIP accuracy, and operational support for cycle counts and physical inventories.
* Partner with Finance to analyze manufacturing variances and carry out corrective actions.
* Prepare ROI justifications for capital requests and track whether completed projects deliver the promised return.

### **Maintenance and facilities**

* Ensure preventive maintenance programs maximize equipment uptime and extend asset life.
* Improve utilization of equipment, facilities and manufacturing capacity.

### **Leadership and people development**

* Lead, coach and develop managers, team leaders and employees across the operation.
* Set annual performance goals and development plans and hold leaders accountable for results.
* Build frontline leaders' capability in problem solving, waste elimination and employee accountability.
* Build organizational depth through hiring, succession planning and cross-training.
* Communicate regularly with employees about performance, company expectations, policies and priorities.

**Requirements**
----------------

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Manufacturing or another technical discipline, or equivalent experience.
* Minimum 10 years in manufacturing with a proven record of success and increasing responsibility.
* Minimum 5 years leading multi-site operations through managers and leaders.
* Demonstrated record of improving safety performance
* Lean Manufacturing experience or certification, with measurable results in efficiency improvement and cost reduction.
* Demonstrated P&L or operating budget accountability.
* Experience with ERP/MRP systems.
* Excellent written and verbal communication and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities at once.
* Willingness to live and work in the greater Louisville, KY area.

**Preferred qualifications**
----------------------------

* Trailer, truck body or similar fabrication, welding and assembly experience.
* Experience in high-mix, custom build-to-order manufacturing.
* MBA or other financial education.

**Working conditions**
----------------------

This role works in both office and manufacturing plant settings, with exposure to noise, welding, painting and moving equipment. Required PPE must be worn on the production floor. The role regularly requires walking and standing for extended periods.

Employment is contingent on successful completion of a background check and drug screen.

Following receipt of a conditional offer of employment, candidates will be required to complete additional job-related screening processes as permitted or required by applicable law.

We are an equal opportunity employer, and all applicants will be considered for employment without attention to their membership in any protected class. If you require any reasonable accommodation to complete your application or any part of the recruiting process, please email your request to careers@marmon.com, and please be sure to include the title and the location of the position for which you are applying.

Why LeoLabs?

At LeoLabs, we're building the living map of activity in space. Through our proprietary global radar network and AI-enabled analytics platform, we collect millions of measurements daily on more than 25,000 objects in low Earth orbit (LEO). Our radar-powered intelligence protects billions in assets, monitors adversarial behavior, and ensures safe operations for commercial and government missions.

We're not just building technology, we are redefining global security, safety, and transparency in space. As orbital activity accelerates and threats grow more complex, LeoLabs is a trusted partner for Space Domain Awareness, Space Traffic Management, and Satellite Operations for top-tier space operators and allied defense organizations.

If you're looking to work on mission-critical challenges at the forefront of aerospace, national security, and AI, your impact starts here.

LeoLabs is seeking a Head of Manufacturing to lead the next phase of production scaling of our radar systems. This leader will own the manufacturing strategy, industrialization roadmap, quality management, facility scaling, and cross-functional execution required to increase production capacity beyond 10x. This role may be leveled as Senior Director or Vice President level based on the successful candidate’s experience, leadership scope and demonstrated ability to own the function. The role with report directly to the SVP, Radars. This role is a full-time, in-person position based at our headquarters in Menlo Park, CA. Regular domestic travel is expected.

The Head of Manufacturing will turn LeoLabs’ advanced radar designs from low/medium-rate initial production into repeatable, scalable, high-rate production systems. You will collaborate with and leverage support from Product, Supply Chain, Radar Systems and Hardware Engineering, Program Management, Finance and Accounting, and executive leadership to build the manufacturing capacity that enables LeoLabs to deploy radar systems more reliably and at greater scale for the U.S. Government, allies, and commercial customers.

The preferred candidate has done this before – they are a leader who has built and sustained a manufacturing system, rather than someone who has only managed an existing operation. This candidate is a hands-on manufacturing executive or emerging executive from a high-performance production environment such as aerospace, defense technology, automotive, or other complex hardware industries. They have scaled production systems from the ground up, built functional teams, improved quality, stood up facilities or production lines, and operated with urgency in environments where reliability, repeatability, and mission success matter.

Key Responsibilities

Manufacturing Strategy & Scale

* Own LeoLabs’ high-rate manufacturing and industrialization strategy for radar systems, subsystems, and associated high-reliability hardware across manufacturing, assembly, integration, and test operations.
* Build and scale a production system and team capable of supporting 10x growth in radar production over the next 2 years while maintaining high standards for quality, reliability, integration, and deployment readiness.
* Define the operating model across internal manufacturing, external suppliers, contract manufacturing, and integration partners.
* Own the high-rate production footprint plan including facility needs, equipment, tooling, staffing, and capital investment.
* Stand up scalable production lines, work cells, fixtures, test stations, documentation, and acceptance processes for radar hardware, RF systems, electronics, electromechanical assemblies, power systems, compute infrastructure, and system-level integration.
* Establish the scaled manufacturing steady state including production planning, throughput management, capacity planning, cost analysis, quality, and delivery execution.

Industrialization

* Own the transition from engineering builds to production-ready designs.
* Establish and mature release and readiness gates, first-article processes, and build documentation.
* Partner with Radar Systems and Hardware Engineering teams to industrialize new radar designs, ensuring manufacturability, testability, serviceability, configuration control, and production readiness.
* Partner with engineering NPI manufacturing team to improve manufacturability, DfX, and cost reduction opportunities.
* Ensure new radar products have validated build plans, test procedures, tooling, factory acceptance testing criteria, and supplier plans before production ramp.
* Create a functioning feedback system from manufacturing and sustainment back into product and engineering.

Quality, Reliability & Production

* Build and mature the quality management system required for high-reliability radar systems serving mission-critical customers.
* Establish clear standards for configuration control, traceability, inspection, nonconformance management, corrective action, supplier quality, and production acceptance.
* Drive measurable improvements in yield, first-pass quality, rework, scrap, field defects, and schedule performance.
* Build strong review mechanisms for failures, escapes, production risks, and systemic issues.
* Partner with Technical Program Management to align production readiness and execution with program, contract, customer, and deployment commitments
* Partner with Supply Chain on supplier readiness, long-lead planning, cost reduction, and risk mitigation.
* Partner with the Radar Operations Center and Global Infrastructure to turn field performance and maintenance data into product and process improvements to increase performance, reduce operational impacts, and decrease maintenance costs.
* Develop manufacturing KPIs and high-level dashboards for throughput, schedule metrics, yield, labor tracking, cost, quality, rework, scrap, supplier performance, and field reliability.

Team Leadership

* Establish and lead the LeoLabs Production System, creating a common operating model for safety, quality, delivery, cost and people. Implement tiered daily management, visual controls, standard work, structured problem solving, leader standard work, production flow, capacity management and continuous improvement.
* Recruit, develop, and lead a world-class manufacturing organization including manufacturing operations, production, test operations, quality, facilities, and related functions.
* Set clear ownership and metrics across the manufacturing organization.
* Build a culture of execution, urgency, accountability, safety, quality, and continuous improvement.

Required Qualifications

* 15+ years of experience in manufacturing, production operations, industrialization, factory operations, manufacturing engineering, or related operational leadership roles.
* Demonstrated experience implementing and leading a mature Lean manufacturing or production operating system, such as the Toyota Production System, including standard work, visual management, daily accountability, structured problem solving, flow, built-in quality, waste reduction and continuous improvement.
* Demonstrated experience scaling production capacity, standing up production lines or facilities, and improving throughput, quality, cost, and delivery performance.
