**ABOUT US**

**Join a Global Photonics Leader Engineering Solutions from the Deep Ocean to Outer Space!**

G&H (Gooch & Housego) designs and manufactures advanced optical components and systems for demanding applications. Our Chicago-area acousto-optics operation employs approximately 20+ people and supports high-precision photonics manufacturing.

**THE OPPORTUNITY**

We are seeking a hands-on Director of Operations to lead a Chicago-area acousto-optics manufacturing site of approximately 20+ employees. This leader will own daily operational execution, workforce performance, safety, quality, delivery and cost, while aligning production capacity, materials and customer demand. Working closely with Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain, Commercial and Finance, the Director will drive disciplined planning and practical continuous improvement.

**WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING**

**Site Leadership & Manufacturing Execution**

* Lead day-to-day site operations, establish priorities, allocate labor and equipment, and coach a small manufacturing team to achieve safety, quality, delivery and productivity objectives.
* Oversee production scheduling, capacity, workflow and bottlenecks for high-precision acousto-optic manufacturing, including high-mix or low-volume requirements where applicable.
* Build a culture of accountability, engagement and cross-functional teamwork consistent with G&H values.
* Change Manage/Leadership of culture
* Fluent in NPI/product transfer for insourcing – Leadership, team formation and oversight, risk identification & mitigation.
* Maturing and scaling production methodologies and technologies.

**Planning, Inventory & Financial Performance**

* Lead site inputs to SIOP, aligning customer demand, backlog, materials and production plans with Commercial and Supply Chain partners.
* Monitor raw materials, work-in-progress, finished goods and safety stock to balance delivery performance, inventory turns and working capital.
* Manage site operating plans and budgets within delegated authority; weekly report out of plan vs actual and financial forecasts using ERP data and operating trends.

**Quality, Safety & Customer Commitments**

* Partner with Quality and Engineering to resolve nonconformances, strengthen root-cause and corrective-action practices, and maintain applicable ISO/AS requirements.
* Champion health and safety, manufacturing process discipline and customer requirements, including aerospace and defense obligations where applicable.
* Coordinate customer delivery risks, new-product introductions, manufacturing readiness and escalation resolution across functions.

**Operational Excellence & Performance**

* Drive practical Lean, 5S and process improvement initiatives to reduce scrap, increase yield and improve throughput and cost.
* Establish an operating cadence and report actionable KPIs including on-time delivery, schedule attainment, scrap/yield, productivity, inventory and safety.
* Use ERP, Excel and business data to identify constraints, prioritize actions and sustain measurable improvements.

**WHAT YOU BRING**

**Qualifications & Skills**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Operations Management, Supply Chain or a related field; advanced degree preferred.
* At least five years of progressive manufacturing leadership experience, including direct people management.
* Experience in precision manufacturing, photonics, optics, electronics or similarly technical operations; acousto-optics strongly preferred.
* Demonstrated production planning, inventory management and operational budgeting experience.
* Working knowledge of ERP systems, Excel and manufacturing performance metrics.
* Experience with Lean, 5S or other continuous improvement methods.
* Ability to lead hands-on in a small-site environment while balancing strategic and daily operational priorities.
* Strong coaching, communication, decision-making and cross-functional stakeholder skills.
* Experience supporting regulated aerospace/defense manufacturing or ISO/AS systems preferred, where applicable.
* Ability to analyze operational data, resolve production constraints and drive sustained improvements.

**G&H BENEFITS INCLUDE:**

* Paid Time Off and Company Holidays
* 401(k) Retirement Plan with Company Match
* Medical, Dental and Vision Insurance
* Life and Disability Insurance
* Enhanced Employee Assistance Program
* Employee Wellness Resources
* Professional Development Opportunities

**If you’re ready to make a real impact in a world-class photonics environment, we’d love to hear from you.**

The Director plays a critical role in operational excellence, customer satisfaction, financial performance, and team member engagement.

This is an opportunity to shape and scale multi-site operations within a growing 3PL organization. The Director of Operations will play a pivotal role in driving operational excellence, strengthening customer partnerships, and developing high-performing teams.

existing_roles.description:
**About David AI**
------------------

At David AI, our vision is to bring impactful AI into billions of lives through voice. Our mission is to help the world's leading AI companies build better voice models and agents. We're building the data and evaluation infrastructure behind those models.

Founded in 2024, we're a fast-growing Series B company backed by NVIDIA, Meritech, First Round, YC, and others, with ~70 people across San Francisco and New York City.

**About our Data Operations team**
----------------------------------

Our Data Operations team powers David AI's Data Factory, transforming raw audio into high-quality training datasets for leading AI labs. Our mandate is to spin up new data pipelines and run them at a massive scale.

This means starting from a model capability we want a model to unlock, experimenting with different shapes of data and collection strategies, and validating them with researchers. Once an approach works, we industrialize it, building pipelines that can process audio with reliability, quality, and efficiency. We are relentless operators who thrive in ambiguity, equally comfortable prototyping novel workflows as we are managing large-scale production systems.

**About this role**
-------------------

As **General Manager of Data Operations** at David AI, you will lead one of the most critical functions at David AI. You’ll own a major slice of our Data Factory: the engine that powers high-quality, scalable data production. You’ll lead the team responsible for building and scaling pipelines, from 0 1 experiments that unlock new model capabilities to 1 N industrialization that processes data reliably and efficiently.

**In this role, you will**
--------------------------

* Build and lead a team of Data Product Operations Leads, to spin up and scale data pipelines, from early experiments to production systems that generate high-quality audio data at scale.
* Act as a thought partner to executive leadership on how we can evolve and scale delivery capabilities in service of customer needs.
* Continuously monitor and improve pipeline health, spotting issues in sourcing, quality, or process early and owning solutions end-to-end.
* Use metrics to drive decisions, tracking throughput, quality, and cost to guide prioritization and identify where to scale or invest next.
* Work with researchers at leading AI labs to identify new model capabilities and turn them into concrete data workflows and project plans.
* Partner with our internal research team to design and test new data shapes that unlock frontier model capabilities.
* Own outcomes across functions, designing systems, managing execution, unblocking bottlenecks, and ensuring delivery at both prototype and production scale.

**Your background looks like**
------------------------------

* 5 to 10+ years of experience in high-ownership roles (e.g., founder, GM, COO, or strategy/ops at a venture-backed startup).
* Prior experience scaling large-scale operational efforts at high-growth startups or fast-paced companies.
* Technical fluency with data and operations; SQL proficiency required.
* Prior experience designing and scaling systems, processes, and teams across different customer segments and product lines.
* A relentless operator with high standards, bias to action, and strong attention to detail.
* Comfortable with ambiguity and rapid pace; thrives in a “build while flying” environment.
* Low-ego, collaborative, and mission-driven, focused on team and company success.

**Bonus points if you have**
----------------------------

* Experience in data, ML, or large-scale operations.
* Background in CS, industrial engineering, or similar.

**Benefits**
------------

* Unlimited PTO.
* Top-notch health, dental, and vision coverage with 100% coverage for most plans.
* FSA & HSA access.
* 401k access.
* Meals 2x daily through DoorDash + snacks and beverages available at the office.
* Unlimited company-sponsored Barry's classes.

**Visas**
---------

We sponsor international candidates across several visa types, including H-1B *transfers*, H-1B1, O-1, E-3, and TN. We also hire candidates on STEM OPT. If you’re on OPT, we’ll want to confirm you have a path to one of the visas listed above before your OPT ends. While we can’t guarantee any individual outcome, we’ve successfully sponsored teammates from all over the world.

Compensation Range: $205K - $235K

protected_roles.title: Quality Director
protected_roles.description:
**Summary**

Provides strategic leadership and direction for the Quality organization, ensuring that quality systems, processes, and practices support business objectives, customer requirements, regulatory compliance, and operational excellence. Establishes quality strategy, policies, objectives, and performance expectations and provides leadership across functions to drive continuous improvement, strengthen quality performance, mitigate risk, and support business growth.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

* Provide strategic leadership and direction for the Quality organization, establishing priorities, objectives, and performance expectations aligned with business and operational goals.
* Lead the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of the site's Quality Management System and associated quality policies, procedures, and controls.
* Serve as the site's senior quality leader and management representative for applicable ISO 9001, AS9100, and ISO 13485 quality management systems.
* Ensure continued compliance with applicable regulatory, customer, industry, and certification requirements, including applicable FDA, ITAR, ISO, and IPC requirements and standards.
* Provide leadership for quality planning related to processes, products, customers, and business requirements, with consideration for broader corporate quality objectives.
* Establish and monitor quality metrics and performance indicators. Identify trends, risks, and systemic issues and lead actions to improve quality performance.
* Provide quality performance, risk, and improvement recommendations to site and organizational leadership.
* Lead the Material Review Board (MRB) process and provide oversight for the disposition and control of nonconforming material and product.
* Provide leadership and oversight for corrective and preventive actions, root cause analysis, and systemic problem resolution in partnership with Engineering, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, and other functions.
* Lead quality improvement initiatives focused on reducing defects, improving process capability, increasing throughput, and strengthening overall operational performance.
* Drive a culture of continuous improvement and quality ownership throughout the organization.
* Provide oversight of internal and external audit activities, certification requirements, customer audits, and resulting corrective actions.
* Partner with Supply Chain and suppliers to evaluate supplier quality performance, address quality risks, and ensure supplier quality systems meet business and customer requirements.
* Oversee the calibration system and applicable preventive maintenance controls to ensure compliance and effectiveness.
* Ensure appropriate training and organizational capability related to workmanship standards, acceptance criteria, quality systems, and regulatory/customer requirements.
* Support environmental management requirements, including applicable ISO 14001 responsibilities and site environmental management activities.
* Partner with Operations, Engineering, Supply Chain, Program Management, and other functions to identify and mitigate quality and operational risks and improve customer outcomes.
* Provide quality leadership and expertise in support of new products, customers, programs, processes, and business opportunities.
* Promote awareness and understanding of regulatory, customer, and quality requirements throughout the organization.
* Lead, develop, and mentor Quality leaders and team members, building organizational capability and ensuring appropriate talent development and succession planning.
* Support corporate and site Lean/6S objectives and integrate quality principles into continuous improvement initiatives.
* Support and follow all applicable Quality Management System requirements related to quality, environmental, health, safety, and security.
* Perform other duties and responsibilities as assigned.

**Job Knowledge, Skills & Abilities**

* Advanced knowledge of quality management systems and quality principles within a complex manufacturing environment.
* Strong knowledge of ISO 9001, AS9100, ISO 13485, and other applicable regulatory and customer quality requirements.
* Working knowledge of FDA, ITAR, IPC, and applicable electronics manufacturing standards and requirements.
* Demonstrated ability to translate business objectives into quality strategies, priorities, metrics, and improvement initiatives.
* Strong knowledge of corrective action, root cause analysis, risk management, process improvement, and continuous improvement methodologies.
* Ability to analyze quality and operational data, identify trends and systemic risks, and develop effective corrective and preventive strategies.
* Strong business acumen with the ability to balance quality, customer, operational, financial, and business considerations.
* Demonstrated ability to influence decisions and drive results across functions without relying solely on direct authority.
* Strong leadership and organizational capability, including experience building, developing, and leading professional and technical teams.
* Ability to communicate effectively with customers, regulatory bodies, auditors, suppliers, and senior leadership.
* Strong written, verbal, presentation, and executive communication skills.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications and applicable electronic manufacturing and quality systems.

**Experience/Education**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Quality, Operations, or a related technical discipline required; advanced degree preferred.
* Minimum of 10 years of progressively responsible quality, engineering, or manufacturing experience, including significant leadership responsibility.
* Demonstrated experience leading a quality organization within a complex manufacturing environment.
* Experience managing multiple concurrent technical, quality, and operational priorities.
* Demonstrated experience influencing cross-functional leaders and driving organization-wide quality and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Experience interacting with customers, auditors, regulatory organizations, and senior business leadership.
* Demonstrated balance of strategic thinking, strong analytical capability, and effective execution.
* Strong business judgment, attention to detail, and written and verbal communication skills.

**Due to ITAR and / or CUI compliance, this position requires candidates to be a U.S. Citizen.**

Benefits Offered: Comprehensive benefit package including medical, dental and vision coverage; company-paid basic life/AD&D insurance, short-term and long-term disability insurance; voluntary supplemental insurances, flexible spending accounts and employee assistance program (EAP). Sick Leave, Vacation Time, and company-paid Holidays are also provided as paid time off. NEOTech also provides a 401(k) Retirement Savings Plan option with a company match.

NEOTech is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex including sexual orientation and gender identity, national origin, disability, protected Veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

NEOTech has a long-standing commitment to maintaining a safe, quality-oriented and productive work environment. We also want all employees to perform their duties safely and efficiently, in a manner that protects their interests and those of their co-workers. We recognize that alcohol and drug abuse pose a threat to the health and safety of NEOTech employees and to the security of the Company’s equipment and facilities. For these reasons, NEOTech is committed to the elimination of drug and alcohol use and abuse in the workplace. Candidates being considered for hire must pass a pre-employment background check and drug test which include screening for illegal drugs and marijuana.

protected_roles.description:
This position is incentive eligible.  
  
  

Do you have the career opportunities as a Group Quality Director you want with your current employer? We have an exciting opportunity for you to join HCA Laboratory Services which is part of the nation's leading provider of healthcare services, HCA Healthcare.

Travel is Required. You will Support 5- Divisions. Must Reside in Utah, Idaho, Nevada, North Carolina, Virginia, Alaska or in the Nashville, TN area.

Job Summary and Qualifications

The Group Quality Director is responsible for implementation of the Laboratory Service Line quality and performance improvement programs for our National Group. This position applies quality and performance improvement approaches to identify and quantify improvement opportunities, facilitate and organization process improvement efforts, drive improvement, and measure outcomes. This role supervises Quality Coordinators in assigned divisions. You will be responsible for laboratory regulatory agency accreditation preparedness, tracking and reporting of specific information; auditing and analysis of processes and systems; statistical analysis of data; formulation of recommendations; and creation of written and verbal reports. The position also requires skills for developing and presenting related training programs for laboratory colleagues and for preparing presentations to and for management.

In This Role You Will:

* Deploy the laboratory clinical quality infrastructure across the National Group divisions.
* Partner with leaders to identify and coordinate implementation of continual improvement projects to improve quality performance.
* Facilitate the growth of vision of laboratory quality and performance, including the dissemination of "best practices" across the country.
* Lead regional process improvement initiatives, provide feedback on standardization opportunities and evaluate success through pre-established criteria.
* Assist with appropriate and timely response to Serious Patient Adverse Events (SPAE)s that involve laboratory operations.
* Lead proactive laboratory quality and safety activities to create hospital laboratories that are highly reliable as reflected in reduced errors, elimination of unsafe processes and increase involvement of staff and pathology medical directors toward a culture of safety.
* Contribute to the achievement of laboratory business and financial goals through optimal division and group performance in quality and patient safety.
* Interface with appropriate personnel at HCA to leverage corporate resources, programs, tools and methodologies for benefit of hospital laboratories.
* Collaborate with and support hospital quality, risk, safety and infection prevention leaders to achieve top ranking in national and state publicly reported data initiatives.
* Participate in regular analysis of laboratory quality and risk performance data, and plan steps for ongoing improvement.
* Work with Corporate and Division medical leaders to support data analysis, reporting, process and outcomes improvement.
* Contribute to ongoing enhancement of enterprise quality reporting methods and dashboards.
* Continuously monitor and evaluate quality outcomes across the group and division, while noting trends and identifying and prioritizing opportunities to improve.
* Assist divisions in building a proactive quality department by implementing processes to support accreditation and regulatory inspections.
* Facilitate and/or lead process improvement teams as needed to achieve quality improvement goals.
* Serve as a regulatory resource regarding state and federal regulations and standards, including but not limited to CMS, CLIA, CAP, and TJC.
* Demonstrate personal responsibility for professional development, and promoting and supporting laboratory quality leaders and division data analysts.
* Promote a culture that is positive, values individual strengths, takes risks and is committed to optimal patient care and compliance with standards.
* Attend HCA-mandated training and meeting all ethics and compliance standards and requirements.
* Develop and implement projects as directed by AVP, Quality and CLO.

What Qualifications You Will Need:

* Bachelor's degree in a clinical laboratory, chemical, biological science or related field is required.
* Master's degree in a related field is preferred.
* 3+ years of experience in quality improvement is required.
* 1+ years of experience in clinical laboratory is preferred.
* Management experience is preferred.
* Previous experience within a multi-facility environment is preferred.
* Clinical licensure, Laboratory Medical Technology or RN is preferred.
* Certified Professional in Healthcare Quality (CPHQ) is preferred.

##### **Benefits**

Work from Home, offers a total rewards package that supports the health, life, career and retirement of our colleagues. The available plans and programs include:

* **Comprehensive benefits** for medical, prescription drug, dental, vision, behavioral health and telemedicine services
* **Wellbeing support,** including free counseling and referral services
* **Time away from work** programs for paid time off, paid family leave, long- and short-term disability coverage and leaves of absence
* **Savings and retirement resources**, including a 401(k) Plan with a 100% match on 3% to 9% of pay (based on years of service), Employee Stock Purchase Plan, flexible spending accounts, preferred banking partnerships, retirement readiness tools, rollover support and financial wellbeing counseling
* **Education support** through tuition assistance, student loan assistance, certification support, dependent scholarships and a partnership with Galen College of Nursing
* **Additional benefits** for fertility and family building, adoption assistance, life insurance, supplemental health protection plans, auto and home insurance, legal counseling, identity theft protection and consumer discounts

Learn more about Employee Benefits

***Note: Eligibility for benefits may vary by location.***

**Integrated Regional Labs** is a full service providerfor clinical laboratory and anatomic pathology services, providing hospitals, physicians, and clients with**timely diagnostic information** for patient care. Our infrastructure includes a fullyautomated esoteric core laboratory in Fort Lauderdale, a histology and microbiology operation in Largo,Florida, and a network of hospital based **rapid-response** laboratories present in fourHCA Healthcare divisions within the state of Florida. Our core laboratories support **more than250** acute and rehab hospitals, physician practices, surgery centers and commercialaccounts.

HCA Healthcare has been recognized as one of the World’s Most Ethical Companies® by the Ethisphere Institute more than ten times. In recent years, HCA Healthcare spent an estimated $3.7 billion in cost for thedelivery of charitable care, uninsured discounts, and other uncompensated expenses.

protected_roles.description:
About Us:

### ***Specialized Care for the Patients Who Need It Most.***

NeuroPsychiatric Hospitals (NPH) is dedicated to providing unparalleled service to our patients, team members, physicians, and families. We dare to do things differently, bringing together compassionate care, specialized expertise, and an interdisciplinary approach to meet the unique needs of those we serve. It is this commitment that distinguishes NPH as the healthcare provider of choice.

As a national leader in behavioral healthcare, NPH specializes in caring for patients with acute psychiatric and complex medical needs. Our hospitals provide patient-centered care through an interdisciplinary, multi-specialty approach, ensuring our patients receive the specialized support they need when they need it most.

With locations in Indiana, Michigan, Texas, Ohio, and Arizona, we are expanding access to our unique model of care across the United States. Join NPH and become part of a team that is daring to do things differently and making a lasting difference in the lives of our patients, families, and communities every day.

Overview:

NeuroPsychiatric Hospitals is looking for a Director of Quality and Risk at our **Huber Heights, OH** location. NPH is the national leader in providing medical and neurobehavioral care to patients in acute psychiatric distress. You will be joining a team of rock star staff who provide exceptional, patient-centered care and understand our patients are always our number one priority! The Director of Quality supports the implementation and monitoring of the quality assurance measurements and audits, and assists in improving patient safety processes throughout the hospital through coordinating and engaging in activities to proactively promote implementation of evidence based best practices and resolve deficiencies; plans, develops, and directs system activities and protocols across NeuroPsychiatric Hospitals; helps to prepare NPH facilities for surveys by accrediting and licensing agencies; serves as a resource to all departments and personnel.

**Benefits of joining NPH as a Director of Quality and Risk**

* Competitive pay rates
* Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance
* NPH 401(k) plan with up to 4% Company match
* Employee Assistance Program (EAP) Programs
* Generous PTO and Time Off Policy
* Special tuition offers through Capella University
* Work/life balance with great professional growth opportunities
* Employee Discounts through LifeMart

Responsibilities:

* Implements and monitors quality goals and objectives to measure the organization’s processes and outcomes while administering programs that focus on improved outcomes of patient care or patient safety.
* Interacts with physicians, nurses, department managers, supervisors, and any/all other staff members to provide resource information and identify new opportunities to improve service and reduce costs.
* Generates effectual quality related policies and procedures for the department and hospital that ensures compliance with JC, OSHA, CDC, CMS and other county, state, and federal regulatory agencies.
* Prepares reports, presentations and statistical data that go to the Quality Assurance and Performance Improvement Committee Meetings, facility's administration and other committees as needed. Analyzes data to identify trends and resource utilization for use in optimizing compliance.
* Assists with the annual assessment of the quality control programs from the prior year activities.
* Investigates incidents within the facility and coordinates with the Corporate Quality team to complete the root cause analysis and develop action plans to prevent incidents in the future.
* Establish a structure to ensure that patient care activities are addressed in a coordinated manner involving quality improvement.
* Prepares the agenda for the Quality Council Committee meetings and holds regularly scheduled meetings.
* Provides educational offerings for orientation and on-going in-services.
* Performs mortality reviews in conjunction with the mortality committee and holds regularly scheduled mortality committee meetings.
* Ensures all staff receive proper education on new or revised state and/ or federal regulations or Joint Commission standards.
* Participates in Multi-disciplinary patient centered case conferences, as appropriate.
* Assess and evaluate patients with infections and monitor patient outcomes on an ongoing basis.
* Initiates follow-up on employee/patient exposures to communicable diseases.
* Participates in root-cause analysis, sentinel events, adverse events and identifies trends as directed by regulation. Recommends ways to redesign systems for improvements if needed.
* Oversee Patient Advocacy program.
* Establishes/maintains good relationships with COO, CEO and DON’s and department leaders to promote a cooperative and constructive environment for improvement.
* Promote “Quality is everyone’s business” to gain support, understanding and ownership among staff.
* Other duties as may be assigned.
* Complies with hospital expectations regarding ethical behavior and standards of conduct.
* Complies with federal and hospital requirements in the areas of protected health information & patient privacy.
* Understands and adheres to NPH’s compliance standards as they appear in NPH’s Corporate Compliance Policy, Code of Conduct and Conflict of Interest Policy.
* Keeps abreast of all pertinent federal, state and hospital regulations, laws and policies as they presently exist and as they change or are modified.
* Performs other duties as assigned.

Qualifications:

* Bachelor's Degree in healthcare field or pertinent program required. Master's Degree preferred.
* 3+ years of relevant healthcare quality and risk management experience. Prior leadership experience preferred.
* Excellent verbal communication skills necessary in order present quality reports.
* Maintain effective contacts with a variety of Hospital Personnel.
* Professional knowledge of clinical practice, leadership, performance improvement and research statistics in order to conduct surveillance and prepare related reports at a level normally acquired through the completion of a Bachelor’s degree in related field.

Founded in 1982 as Joliet Area Community Hospice, Lightways Hospice and Serious Illness Care is an independent, nonprofit healthcare provider licensed in 11 counties in northwest Illinois. We provide exceptional serious illness care, hospice care and grief support for adults and children.

The majority of our direct patient care is in the field with Lightways team members providing care in the home, nursing facility or assisted living facility. We also have a 24-bed inpatient unit in Joliet. Non-clinical staff are based out of our Joliet administrative offices.

**Director of Quality and Compliance**

The Director of Quality & Compliance provides administrative oversight for Quality, Compliance, Medical Records, and Risk Management functions, while also serving as the organization’s designated Compliance Officer.

This role delivers strategic and operational leadership for the Lightways Quality Assessment & Performance Improvement (QAPI) program, regulatory compliance, accreditation readiness, clinical education, and risk management. The Director is responsible for developing, implementing, and evaluating robust systems that promote safety, regulatory adherence, and high-quality care across all organizational operations.

  

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Reference, research, report, track, and monitor compliance and quality-related data.
* Develop, implement, and evaluate strategies for quality assurance, performance improvement, risk management, and regulatory compliance.
* Create and maintain the organization’s annual Quality and Compliance Plans and Reports.
* Lead quarterly Quality Assessment and Performance Improvement (QAPI) meetings.
* Review Consumer Assessment of Healthcare Providers and Systems (CAHPS) survey data, complaints, and incident reports to inform improvement strategies.
* Develop and deliver education, policies, and process improvements to promote accurate, timely, and compliant clinical documentation across the organization.

  

**Education/Experience:**

* Master's degree in healthcare or related field (required)
* Management experience with hospice and/or palliative care experience preferred.
* Certification in a specialist area preferred; (e.g. Hospice and Palliative Nursing (CHPN), Pediatrics or Geriatrics)

  

**Benefits:**

* 401(k) matching
* Health Insurance
* Dental Insurance
* Vision Insurance
* Personal Time Off
* Holiday Paid

Delta Precision Components, LLC and its’ divisions of Delta Gear and Delta Research is a growing manufacturer of advanced gears, precision gears, shafts, splines, carriers, housings, gauges and & other components and assemblies for primarily the aerospace and defense industry. We are AS9100 and ISO9001-registered facility. For over 40 years, we’ve built a culture of stability and growth—now we are looking for passionate individuals to join our team and grow with us.

  

**WHY JOIN US?**

At our core, quality is about more than compliance—it's about safely putting people in the air. This is a unique opportunity for a results-driven leader to challenge the status quo, drive measurable improvements and build organizational capability. If you are passionate about continuous improvement, operational excellence, and leading meaningful change, you'll play a critical role in strengthening customer confidence, improving business performance, and shaping the next chapter of our growth.

  

**Summary**

Reporting to the Vice President, Quality, the incumbent will lead the company's quality strategy, systems, and culture. Responsible for ensuring product quality, regulatory compliance, customer satisfaction, and continuous improvement. Responsible for leadership for quality professionals.

  

**Responsibilities**

* Develop and execute the company's quality vision, strategy, and performance objectives.
* Lead Quality Assurance, Quality Control, Supplier Quality, and Continuous Improvement.
* Maintain compliance with customer, regulatory, and industry quality standards, including AS9100.
* Drive customer satisfaction through proactive quality management, problem resolution, and performance improvement.
* Champion root cause analysis, corrective actions, risk mitigation, and defect prevention.
* Partner with Operations, Engineering, Supply Chain, and Commercial teams to improve operational excellence and business performance.
* Lead customer audits, internal audits for site and division, management reviews, and quality system assessments.
* Build, develop, and mentor a high-performing quality organization.

  

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering or a related technical discipline; advanced degree preferred.
* 15+ years of progressive quality leadership experience in aerospace, automotive, or other highly regulated manufacturing environments.
* Demonstrated success developing and leading certified quality management systems and customer-focused quality initiatives.

* Own diagnostics, functional testing, and EOL validation. Deliver vehicles to fleet and engineering teams safely, complete, and on time.
* Implement repeatable build processes and keep accurate hardware and software configuration records for every vehicle. Ensure each vehicle meets quality and product specifications.
* Prepare and manage the line's OPEX, CAPEX, and headcount budgets. Identify investments that improve throughput, quality, and flexibility.
* Ensure MES and QMS support prototype builds, including traceability and issue tracking. Drive continuous improvement through the Zoox Production System.
* Hire, train, and develop technicians, leads, and supervisors. Set clear expectations and evaluate performance.
* Build a culture that puts employee and product safety first, in partnership with EHS. Enforce safe practices for high-voltage systems and pre-production vehicles.

### **Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Management, or a related field.
* 15+ years of experience in vehicle or complex electromechanical assembly manufacturing (e.g., automotive, aerospace, robotics), including prototype, pilot, or NPI builds.
* 5+ years of experience leading production teams, including supervisors or managers.
* Proven ability to lead hardware and software engineers to resolve build issues under schedule pressure, often without direct authority.
* Working knowledge of vehicle systems (mechanical, electrical, high-voltage, embedded software) and how they are built, diagnosed, and tested.
* Experience transitioning new products from prototype into serial production.
* Familiarity with MES, ERP, and QMS, and with structured problem-solving (e.g., 8D, root cause analysis).
* Clear communicator who can present build status, risks, and trade-offs to executives.

### **Bonus Qualifications**

* Experience with autonomous, electric, or other software-defined vehicles.
* Experience building or retrofitting R&D or test-fleet vehicles.
* Experience applying lean principles in low-volume, high-mix production.

**Base Salary Range**

There are three major components to compensation for this position: salary, Amazon Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), and Zoox Stock Appreciation Rights. A sign-on bonus may be offered as part of the compensation package. The listed range applies only to the base salary. Compensation will vary based on geographic location and level. Leveling, as well as positioning within a level, is determined by a range of factors, including, but not limited to, a candidate's relevant years of experience, domain knowledge, and interview performance. The salary range listed in this posting is representative of the range of levels Zoox is considering for this position.

Zoox also offers a comprehensive package of benefits, including paid time off (e.g. sick leave, vacation, bereavement), unpaid time off, Zoox Stock Appreciation Rights, Amazon RSUs, health insurance, long-term care insurance, long-term and short-term disability insurance, and life insurance.

These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. protected_roles.description:
**Company Summary: PuraGraft, a Young Innovations Company**

PuraGraft represents the leading manufacturers of biomaterial solutions for bone and tissue regeneration. No single material can suit all medical requirements and indications. However, through PuraGraft® you have access to the widest choices of products.

At Young Innovations, we foster a dynamic environment where team members make an impact every day as part of a collaborative, inclusive culture. Together, we serve the dental profession and their patients, united in our mission of achieving a Lifetime of Oral Health™

We embrace diverse perspectives and encourage bold thinking, challenging traditional approaches with a bias for action. Whether you’re looking to expand your skills or grow your career, Young is here to support your goals and continuous learning. At Young, YOU are at the core of what we do.

**Position Overview:**

Reporting to the VP Quality Regulatory Affairs, the Sr. Manager, Quality Assurance will be tasked with ensuring Quality standards are met or exceeded in all facets of the multi-site operation. He/she will partner internally in the development and implementation of new or adjusted quality standards, policies, and procedures, as required at Kingwood, TX and Scottsdale, AZ.

**You’ll like this role if:**

* You enjoy leading a team, solving complex quality challenges, and turning data into practical improvements. You take ownership of compliance and thrive in a hands-on role supporting quality standards across multiple sites.

**Why You’ll Love Working Here:**

* Medium sized company – not too big, not too small – just enough to get things done and see your impact.
* Did we say benefits? Full medical, dental, vision, 401k, parental leave, paid holidays, paid time off, short & long term disability insurance, employee assistance program, and more!
* Lead and inspire a dedicated team, build meaningful relationships, and help your employees grow and succeed.

**Who you’ll work with:**

* You’ll report to the VP of Quality & Regulatory Affairs and lead Quality Associates supporting our Kingwood, TX and Scottsdale, AZ operations.
* You’ll partner closely with QRA, Sourcing, Distribution, and Production teams to strengthen quality systems and drive continuous improvement.

**What You’ll Do:**

* Act as the site’s Sr. Quality and Compliance Leader, and when necessary, as the site’s Designated Management Representative to ensure compliance with all regulatory, corporate and facility requirements.
* Ensure compliance of two sites.
* Ensure outstanding Quality System performance via monitoring and measuring of process performance, and driving any appropriate action, including issuing and follow-up on activities required for sourcing, warehousing, and distributing pharmaceuticals.
* Supervise & Manage Quality Associates and develop culture of collaboration and cross-functional success within the department and business.
* Reviews and monitors Quality metrics and reports trends, to determine if there is a need to escalate issues to the management.
* Perform, review and monitor the Quality Management processes which include but is not limited to:
  + Ensure compliance with FDA, DEA and BOP requirements, including DSCSA traceability of pharmaceuticals.
  + Oversee Regulatory activities associated with distribution licensing, drug distribution reports, and permits for warehousing and distribution of controlled substances.
  + inspection and product release, label approval, calibration, warehousing controls, record retention, document control, training, control of non-conforming product, quarantined Products, control of access and drugs storage, including temperature monitoring.
  + Host and manage internal and external audits. Ensure the site’s readiness for assessments and lead implementation of corrective actions.
  + Effectively assess processes and identify opportunities for improvement.
  + Review, Analyze and Report Statistical findings through critical thought and storytelling of key findings and opportunities to all levels within a matrixed organization.
  + Partner with other departments to identify critical to quality metrics, and support the operationalization of monitoring and management to deliver improved performance across processes.
  + Create effective and compelling visual materials/presentations that support the process/product improvement impact to the organization and adequately represent the impact to quality, cost and time.
  + Define, track, and monitor key success measures associated with Quality Management Systems. Successfully deploy and support change management and appropriate training plans.
* Manage document control functions, including creation, review, and approval of procedures, work instructions and all other documentation for the Quality System.
* Manage the complaint handling system, including trending and review to identify opportunities for improvement.
* Manage the training of the Site, by maintaining the training log, tracking training completion of training by site personnel, creating training content and hosting group training as needed.
* Develop and host the Quarterly Management Review
* Manage the Recall process, from notification, tracking responses & expenses, reporting, and closure.
* Develop, refine, and/or maintain quality standards, policies, and procedures for the facility, including identifying, recommending, and fully implementing changes, in partnership with corporate QRA and local operations teams. Other duties as assigned

**What You’ll Bring:**

* Bachelor’s degree in technical field.
* Minimum of 3 Years of experience managing manufacturing and/or distribution of pharmaceuticals.
* Minimum of 3 Years of experience having direct responsibility for managing a Quality group.
* Direct experience managing FDA or DEA Inspections.
* Demonstrated proficiency in verbal and written communication in English, with the ability to convey information clearly, accurately, and professionally across all levels of the organization.

**Travel Requirements**

* Up to 15%

**Work Environment:**

**Office Environment**

This position is based in an office environment and is primarily sedentary in nature. It requires regular use of standard office equipment, including computers, phones, photocopiers, scanners, filing cabinets, and fax machines. Some roles may involve wearing a headset and sustained computer use for 8 or more hours per day. Employees may be required to sit, stand, or walk for extended periods, and occasional bending, lifting, or carrying items up to 50 pounds may be necessary.

**Manufacturing/Distribution Environment**

This position operates in a manufacturing plant environment. The role routinely involves working around machinery, equipment, and moving mechanical parts. The facility may be subject to varying temperatures, loud noise levels, and airborne particles such as dust or chemical fumes, depending on the area of the plant. This role may require periods of standing, sitting, or walking throughout the workday. Occasional bending, lifting, or carrying items up to 50 pounds may be necessary.

Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, depth perception and ability to adjust focus. While performing the duties of this Job, the employee is regularly required to sit; use hands to finger, handle, control, or feel; reach with hands and arms and talk. Hearing abilities required for this environment include being able to clearly hear and respond to audible alarms, production equipment, forklifts, and other machinery to maintain a safe work environment. Individuals must be able to distinguish and understand verbal communication including instructions, safety warnings, and team discussions, sometimes in an environment with moderate to high background noise.

*US: Young Innovations, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer and E-Verify participating employer.*

protected_roles.description:
**NOTICE: The posting for local applicants only - is not for those applying for a global assignment and/or for employees working outside of Cipla's U.S. Subsidiaries or Affiliates.**

  

**Job Title**: Senior. Manager, Quality Control

**FLSA Classification**: Full-Time, Exempt Professional

**Work Location**: Central Islip, NY (Unit 3)

**Work Hours:** General Shift: 8:30AM – 5:00PM (may vary based on business needs)

**Reports To**: Quality Control Director

**Salary: $103,000 - $136,000**

  

**Position Summary**

The Manager, Finished Product & Stability Quality Control is responsible for leading all analytical testing, stability program execution, laboratory compliance activities, investigations, and personnel management associated with Finished Product and Stability testing. The role ensures compliance with cGMP, FDA, ICH, USP, Data Integrity, and internal quality requirements while supporting product release, stability commitments, regulatory inspections, and continuous improvement initiatives.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Manage Finished Product and Stability testing activities to support commercial product release and ongoing stability programs.
* Oversee testing and review of assay, related substances, chromatographic purity, degradation products, dissolution, content uniformity, residual solvents, and other compendial requirements.
* Ensure timely execution of stability sample pulls, testing, data review, trending, and reporting activities.
* Lead laboratory investigations including OOS, OOT, deviations, atypical results, and CAPA implementation.
* Review and approve analytical data, laboratory records, chromatograms, and technical reports.
* Support method verification, method transfer, process validation, cleaning validation, and troubleshooting activities.
* Ensure inspection readiness and actively support regulatory and customer audits.
* Supervise, train, mentor, and develop laboratory personnel while ensuring efficient workload distribution and resource utilization.
* Partner with QA, Manufacturing, Validation, Regulatory Affairs, Supply Chain, and R&D to meet business and compliance objectives.
  

**Required Qualifications & Experience**

* Bachelor's or Master's Degree in Chemistry, Pharmaceutical Sciences, or related scientific discipline.
* Minimum 5+ years of pharmaceutical Quality Control experience with at least 3-5 years in a supervisory or managerial role.
* Strong experience supporting FDA-regulated pharmaceutical manufacturing environments.

  

**Technical Knowledge & Competencies**

* Hands-on experience in Finished Product and Stability sample testing within a pharmaceutical Quality Control laboratory. Experience with Raw Material testing is preferred.
* Strong knowledge of chromatographic techniques including assay testing, related substances (impurity profiling), degradation product analysis, and chromatographic purity determination using HPLC, UPLC, GC, and IC systems.
* Proficient in operation, troubleshooting, and lifecycle management of analytical instruments including HPLC, UPLC, GC, IC, Dissolution Testers, Karl Fischer, FTIR, UV-Vis, and XRPD.
* Thorough understanding of Oral Solid Dosage (OSD) product testing requirements and regulatory expectations.
* Strong technical expertise in pharmaceutical analytical methodologies, laboratory investigations, data review, and compliance-driven laboratory operations.
* Working knowledge of cGMP, GLP, GDP, Data Integrity requirements, USP, ICH guidelines, and FDA expectations.
* Experience with chromatography data systems and laboratory software including Empower, LabSolutions, Tiamo, and other computerized laboratory systems.
* Working knowledge of Laboratory Information Management Systems (LIMS), Electronic Laboratory Notebook (ELN), and Quality Management Systems such as TrackWise.
* Demonstrated experience in method execution, method troubleshooting, data review, technical assessments, and investigation management.
* Experience supporting regulatory inspections and customer audits, including USFDA, customer, and corporate audits.
* Strong leadership, communication, documentation, decision-making, and problem-solving skills with the ability to effectively manage teams and collaborate across functions.

  

**GLOBAL COMPANY**

  

Cipla is a leading global pharmaceutical company, dedicated to high-quality, branded and generic medicines. We are trusted by healthcare professionals and patients across geographies. Over the last eight decades, we have strengthened our leadership in India’s pharmaceutical industry and fortified our promise of strengthening our global focus by consolidating and deepening our presence in the key markets of India, South Africa, the U.S., and other economies of the emerging world.

  

Cipla employs handpicked professionals not just for their knowledge and experience but for their zeal to make a difference to the world of healthcare. The company believes that our biggest assets are the employees, who lead us to prosperity and growth in the future. Driven by the vision, none shall be denied, Cipla’s focus has always been on making affordable, world-class medicines with a reputation for uncompromising quality standards across the world.

  

**CIPLA NEW YORK (INVAGEN PHARMACEUTICALS, INC.)**

  

About InvaGen Pharmaceuticals, a Cipla subsidiary InvaGen Pharmaceuticals, Inc. is engaged in the development, manufacture, marketing, and distribution of generic prescription medicines with focus on a range of therapeutic areas, including cardiovascular, anti-infective, CNS, anti-inflammatory, anti-diabetic, and anti-depressants. The company was founded in 2003 and is based in Central Islip and Hauppauge, New York. As of February 18, 2016, InvaGen Pharmaceuticals, Inc. operates as a subsidiary of Cipla (EU) Limited.

**EEO Statement**

  

Cipla is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, religion, national origin, genetic information, disability, or protected veteran status.

protected_roles.description:
**About David AI**
------------------

At David AI, our vision is to bring impactful AI into billions of lives through voice. Our mission is to help the world's leading AI companies build better voice models and agents. We're building the data and evaluation infrastructure behind those models.

Founded in 2024, we're a fast-growing Series B company backed by NVIDIA, Meritech, First Round, YC, and others, with ~70 people across San Francisco and New York City.

**About our Data Operations team**
----------------------------------

Our Data Operations team powers David AI's Data Factory, transforming raw audio into high-quality training datasets for leading AI labs. Our mandate is to spin up new data pipelines and run them at a massive scale.

This means starting from a model capability we want a model to unlock, experimenting with different shapes of data and collection strategies, and validating them with researchers. Once an approach works, we industrialize it, building pipelines that can process audio with reliability, quality, and efficiency. We are relentless operators who thrive in ambiguity, equally comfortable prototyping novel workflows as we are managing large-scale production systems.

**About this role**
-------------------

As **General Manager of Data Operations** at David AI, you will lead one of the most critical functions at David AI. You’ll own a major slice of our Data Factory: the engine that powers high-quality, scalable data production. You’ll lead the team responsible for building and scaling pipelines, from 0 1 experiments that unlock new model capabilities to 1 N industrialization that processes data reliably and efficiently.

**In this role, you will**
--------------------------

* Build and lead a team of Data Product Operations Leads, to spin up and scale data pipelines, from early experiments to production systems that generate high-quality audio data at scale.
* Act as a thought partner to executive leadership on how we can evolve and scale delivery capabilities in service of customer needs.
* Continuously monitor and improve pipeline health, spotting issues in sourcing, quality, or process early and owning solutions end-to-end.
* Use metrics to drive decisions, tracking throughput, quality, and cost to guide prioritization and identify where to scale or invest next.
* Work with researchers at leading AI labs to identify new model capabilities and turn them into concrete data workflows and project plans.
* Partner with our internal research team to design and test new data shapes that unlock frontier model capabilities.
* Own outcomes across functions, designing systems, managing execution, unblocking bottlenecks, and ensuring delivery at both prototype and production scale.

**Your background looks like**
------------------------------

* 5 to 10+ years of experience in high-ownership roles (e.g., founder, GM, COO, or strategy/ops at a venture-backed startup).
* Prior experience scaling large-scale operational efforts at high-growth startups or fast-paced companies.
* Technical fluency with data and operations; SQL proficiency required.
* Prior experience designing and scaling systems, processes, and teams across different customer segments and product lines.
* A relentless operator with high standards, bias to action, and strong attention to detail.
* Comfortable with ambiguity and rapid pace; thrives in a “build while flying” environment.
* Low-ego, collaborative, and mission-driven, focused on team and company success.

**Bonus points if you have**
----------------------------

* Experience in data, ML, or large-scale operations.
* Background in CS, industrial engineering, or similar.

**Benefits**
------------

* Unlimited PTO.
* Top-notch health, dental, and vision coverage with 100% coverage for most plans.
* FSA & HSA access.
* 401k access.
* Meals 2x daily through DoorDash + snacks and beverages available at the office.
* Unlimited company-sponsored Barry's classes.

**Visas**
---------

We sponsor international candidates across several visa types, including H-1B *transfers*, H-1B1, O-1, E-3, and TN. We also hire candidates on STEM OPT. If you’re on OPT, we’ll want to confirm you have a path to one of the visas listed above before your OPT ends. While we can’t guarantee any individual outcome, we’ve successfully sponsored teammates from all over the world.

Compensation Range: $205K - $235K
